all sites are walk-in. Group sites available. Camping for kayakers (registration required) at Refugee Cove and Seal Cove. 





At Cape Chignecto, towering 180 m (600 ft.) sea cliffs rise from the Bay of Fundy, while the world's highest tides lap at their base. Best described as a wilderness park, it has 29 km (18 mi.) of pristine coastline, deep valleys, sheltered coves, rare plants, and remnant old-growth forests. The park offers over 53 km (33 mi) of wilderness trails, a picnic area overlooking the Bay of Fundy, and remote walk-in campsites. Cape Chignecto provides an excellent opportunity for wilderness hiking, back-country camping and sea kayaking.

quebec-established.name: Driftwood Provincial Park
quebec-established.notes:
Vehicle Camping
Ottawa Campground is the larger campground with two thirds of the park’s campsites located here. There is a full-service, barrier-free comfort station that includes showers, flush toilets and laundry facilities. Many of the campsites are waterfront. All campsites are non-electrical and have a picnic table and fire ring.

All campsites in Brumm Campground are electrical and are geared toward larger trailer units and RVs. Pull-through campsites are available and each site has a picnic table and fire ring.

Group Camping
Two group campsites are available for larger, organized groups. Reservations can be made online or by phone.

Barrier Free
A barrier-free site is located beside the comfort station in Ottawa East Campground and can be reserved through the Ontario Parks central reservation service.

Boat Launch
A boat launch and small docking facility is provided for access to the Ottawa River.

Comfort Station(s)
The comfort station, located in the Ottawa East Campground is a modern facility with showers, flush toilets and laundry facilities.

Day Use
The day use area provides a small sand beach and grassed picnic area on the shores of the Ottawa River.

Flush Toilets
Both the comfort station and small washrooms located throughout the campground contain flush toilets.

Laundromat
A coin operated washer and dryer is located at the comfort station.

Park Store
Canoe rentals, ice, firewood and a selection of souvenir merchandise can be purchased at the park store.

Rentals
Rental canoes are conveniently located in the campground and day use area on the shores of the Ottawa River. Rentals include Personal Floatation Devices (PFDs), paddles and a boat safety kit.

http://www.ontarioparks.com/park/driftwood

quebec-established.name: Mistagance Campground
quebec-established.notes: Very good campground with recently renovated washrooms. Showers are hot and free. Some Hiking trails start directly at the campground. If you plan to do the Waber Falls Hike it is a 30 minute drive.

quebec-established.name: Five Islands Provincial Park
quebec-established.notes: Many sites that have views overlooking the water from high above. Some sites have water and 30amp. WiFi is free at the camp office.

quebec-established.name: Camping Matapédia - Pourvoirie
quebec-established.notes: Cute small camping spot. 35$/night. Perfect to spend a night

quebec-established.name: Lac Chat NP Campground
quebec-established.notes:
National Park Campground , electricity+water, showers (~ 30CAN )
No WiFi or Cell Service but there is a very nice "Center decouverte" close by with wifi, coffee and very comfortable sofas. You can relax there after doing your hikes! We enjoyed it very much.

quebec-established.name: Cheticamp NP Campground
quebec-established.notes:
National Park Campground - Visitor Center is 50m away - very short drive to the Skyline Trail - Fast Wifi 
Don't miss the Arcadian Trail which starts directly behind the campground.
We had quite a few biting flies at the campsite.

quebec-established.name: Lac Kénogami Campground
quebec-established.notes: Regular campground with service or without.. whatever you want. After high season perfect and quite. Pretty sure to many people and noise in high season has ~ 200 places. While being here there where only 2 other camper onsite

quebec-established.name: Fjord Camping
quebec-established.notes: A nice rustic campground managed by a few young people. Very clean, very quiet. 20 C$ without electricity, hot shower included.

quebec-established.name: 3 Monts de Coleraine
quebec-established.notes: We stayed one night in the parking lot of the Visitor Centre at the north end of 3 Monts. Nice trails and outdoor activities close to Thetford Mines. Right beside the road but barely any traffic in the evening. It’s winter now and the Centre is closed for the season so not sure if you will be able to stay here when it’s open.

quebec-established.name: River Ryan Campground
quebec-established.notes: Cute little campground next to the ocean. Each space has its own outside table. The owner is a very nice lady. You can hear a bit the noise of the road not far but not very much. Wifi is available but our space was too far to get it.

quebec-established.name: Parc de la République
quebec-established.notes: Parking place at the entrance of the park - very nice.  There is also a campground next to it. Do not mix up with jardin botanique which is next to it but closes at 5 pm.

quebec-established.name: Le Gîte du campeur
quebec-established.notes: 4 Wild sites near Lac Gaumond, Québec,Canada. Welcome R.V completly autonome, no services.Pedestryan trail, trout fishing, boat and canoë renting.

quebec-established.name: Parc National d'Oka
quebec-established.notes: Camping with or without services, to choose. Also ready-to-camp.Park with beach, hiking trails, bike trails, cross-country skiing, snowshoeing. Historic site, Calvary of Oka. Summer sports and winter sports, kayaking, sailing, beach.

quebec-established.name: Green Point CG
quebec-established.notes: Beautiful campground that's open year round. We were afraid that we might not be able to access it this time of year but we were lucky, after a tiny patch of snow several campsites were snow free. There was even an open pit toilet. Amazing views, quiet, trail nearby and beach access.

quebec-established.name: MacIntosh Brooks
quebec-established.notes: camping sans services (eau et électricité)

quebec-established.name: Camping du Cyp rouge
quebec-established.notes:
Nice, all services. Friendly staff. Some very nice places along a small river. Or directly at the cliff with a view to the lighthouse Shiphead.

Lots of full time guests, but also for campers. 



Open from mid-may

quebec-established.name: Oak Bay Campground
quebec-established.notes: Great little campground we found just after driving across the border into New Brunswick. Owners were super friendly, Park is in great condition. Main park area has serviced sites, 30 amp with sewer and water, well behaved dogs are allowed, and there is great access to the beach for walks at low tide. Main campground area is visible from the road, but traffic noise is not noticeable. There are also some primitive campsites back in the trees a bit if you don’t need services and have a smaller rig. I am here in the early season so I’m sure he gets a lot busier during the summer but, in early May this place is delightful! Not nearly as crowded as the parks closer to, and in St. Andrew.

quebec-established.name: Voyageur Provincial Park
quebec-established.notes: Typical Provincial Park at Ottawa River, including dumping station. Showers were only slightly warm, maybe it's better at another building. The outlets for electricity are sometimes pretty far away from the sites, so a 10 m extension cord may be not enough.

quebec-established.name: Campbells Cove
quebec-established.notes: Campground at road #16, in the east. Perfect location, directly boarding sea and beach. 2way sites, 3way sites, unserviced sites, cabins. Open from end of May. CAD 30,50 incl tax for 2way.

quebec-established.name: Parc De La Gorge De Coaticook
quebec-established.notes:
Nice big campground. It looks very nice for families and kids. There's a lot of hiking trails from the campground.

TIP: if you plan to do the suspension bridge and camping here. Register first, because the admission for the bridge is included in the price (Bridge is $8).

The campground is a bit expensive, $40 for an unpowered site.

quebec-established.name: Petit-Gaspé
quebec-established.notes:
Nice campground in the national park. It looks like they renovated during the winter.
Unfortunately the female showers were luke warm, but the male ones were hot.
Unserviced is $25.50 a night (without entry to the NP)

quebec-established.name: Bayside Campground
quebec-established.notes: Large, grassy place. 2way and 3way service. 2way: CAD 40,25 inkl tax. Nice lawns, little playground.

quebec-established.name: Cote a Fabiene
quebec-established.notes:
Small campsite beside South Kouchimbouguace. 
Just 21 spots for RV and Tent.
15.70 for one with an RV and two adults.
Dry toilets no shower no water.

In main season you need to make a reservation at least 3 months ahead! They seem to be quite messy with their reservation as some sites aren't marked as reserved so you think it's a free site but in fact it is not so you'll have to leave...

quebec-established.name: Camping Municipal De La Pointe, Quebec
quebec-established.notes:
Nice municipal camping, peaceful and quiet. 90 places with mostly hook-ups and pull-throughs.
There are tent sites and also some van sites.
Booking recommend: 1 844 344 4281

quebec-established.name: Wolfe Point Campground
quebec-established.notes:
Lovely campground in the trees with hot showers & laundry if needed. 

This campsite allows for open fires compared to the base camp down the road which didn’t but you’ll have to pay an additional fee of $7 cash if you would like to have one. 

The unserviced spot for the night was $33. You pay for the spot and not per person which is ideal and reasonably priced!

Make sure you have a national park permit which you can buy by entering the park or at the campground desk.

No WiFi and very limited cell service (if any).

quebec-established.name: Pine Hill Campground
quebec-established.notes: Large place, all lawns, near Charlottetown. Many seasonal campers. Perfect washrooms, large well equipped laundry (ironing board!). Large pool, in season only. Playground. Price: 2way 15 amps 43,80 incl tax.

quebec-established.name: Cavendish Sunset RV Park
quebec-established.notes: Huge park in mostly wooded terrain. Some places under spruces, some on grass. Right now still in preparation for main season. Washrooms good. Rec. area. Close to Candish Boardwalk. WiFi yes  but not working today. Too touristy for my taste but ok for 1 night if off-season. Price 2way 15 amps CAD 40,25 incl tax.

quebec-established.name: Cabot Beach Provincial Park
quebec-established.notes: Nice, large campground close to cliff and sea. We checked in on their first day of season and they weren't quite fully prepared (no wifi pw at hand, some washrooms closed, etc). But it's a nice place, with huge lawns and meadows. Province should provide some funds for renovation of washrooms.

quebec-established.name: Chez les Maury
quebec-established.notes: Camping à la ferme. Camping at the farm. Simple, nice, clean place. Wifi works only outside close to the house. They grow grapes here, and blueberrys. Has own small beach. Degustation of farm products possible. RV friendly. Price usually include tasting

quebec-established.name: Motel Camping Haché
quebec-established.notes: Large camping (+ Motel) in Nigadoo. Lots of seasonal campers. Not particulary nice, but ok. Clean bathrooms. In Nigadoo are several eaterys. OK for one night. We payed CAD 39 for 2way.

quebec-established.name: Camping de la Pointe Taylor
quebec-established.notes: Belongs to the provincial park. Large campground, nice and freshly done. Washrooms all new, nice and clean. Wifi works only in open spaces. 2way sites in wooded terrain, others in the open. Access to a wild beautiful beach and a nice municipal park (playground). Small shopping with daily needs nearby. Camping has small playground, too. Very nice place, a bit pricey but it's worth. 2way site CAD 45.

quebec-established.name: Waweig River Campground & Cabins
quebec-established.notes: This place hasn’t been well kept and has dirty bathrooms. Terrible mosquitoes (although a lot of the area is). Access to water is one plus. Ground is soft and road is a little rough coming in so not suitable for large rigs.

quebec-established.name: Camping de la montagne d'argent
quebec-established.notes:
Beautiful campsite, quiet and well maintained. Beautiful sandy beach by the red river.
---
Beau camping, calme et bien entretenu. Belle plage de sable au bord de la riviere rouge.

quebec-established.name: Camping A la Roche
quebec-established.notes: Large nice camping at the banks of St.Lawrence river. Pretty spaciuous sites. Clean bathrooms, laundry, showers with quarters. They have a few 15 amp sites for only $ 37 incl tx. Good!

quebec-established.name: FaunENord Ecocamping
quebec-established.notes: Full service municipal campground near Chibougamau, QC on Route 167. (2 km to town). $32 for 2 services, more for 3 services, less for tenting. Picnic tables, fire pits. Nice clean showers and washrooms. Laundry available $1.50/ machine. Nice trail from campground near Lac Savauge.

quebec-established.name: Lake Embarras
quebec-established.notes: Stayed July 21 and the bugs were out pretty heavy. The sites are just off a nice beach with clear water. We were bothered by loud fisherman late into the night with lots of large RVs with expensive boats that are parked on that same beach. Nice place otherwise and has outhouse

quebec-established.name: Port-Cartier, Ile Patterson
quebec-established.notes:
Official campsite belonging to Camping le Paradis. It was formerly disused but was bought back. $26/night for a service-free site with picnic table and fireplace.
.....
Camping officiel appartenant au Camping le Paradis. Était anciennement désaffecté mais a été racheté. 26$/nuit pour un site sans service avec table de picnic et foyer

quebec-established.name: Camping de la Mer
quebec-established.notes:
Nice Campground right at the beach of the St. Lawrence, all amenities, fast WiFi.
Homemade bread at the counter available.
Cheaper than Camp Boreal.

quebec-established.name: Camping Municipale st Charles de Bourgets
quebec-established.notes: très belle emplacement propre service de douche toilette environ une 12  emplacements près du débarcadère a bateau pour aller sur le Saguenay  table a picnic cabane a patate et crème molle en haut près de l auberge restaurant a l auberge aussi vraiment un beau coin a voir et revoir

quebec-established.name: Camping du Gouffre
quebec-established.notes: Nice (big) campground/RV park on two levels along the river (Rivière du Gouffre) with a small sandy beach, a swimming pool (dirty at time of my visit), children's playground, small shop, very clean sanitary facilities, friendly service. 20 (of about 140) sites for long-term use. Tent sites without hookups $36, sites with water and electricity $44, full hookups $48.

quebec-established.name: Camping Biencourt
quebec-established.notes: Fairly big campground situated directly on a lake. Access over good gravel road. Most sites are seasonally occupied but overnighters are welcome. With my small rig I got a site in front of an empty cabin right on the water. Very friendly and helpful staff. Prices: $20 without, $30 with full hookups. WiFi at office only. Snack bar open daily during season starting mid-June. Kitchen facility, bathroom and shower in community house. During this time of the year black flies are abundant!

quebec-established.name: Centre plain air du lac ferré. (camping)
quebec-established.notes:
Ici on plante la tente sur la plage d'un grand lac, on y est très agréablement reçu par Gina, pendant qu'on monte la tente, Alain l'un des anciens globe-trotteurs de la place nous fait le spectacle et s'amuse avec sa nouvelle chaloupe! l'ambiance est très calme et décontracté!

Électricité sur site (tente compris), location d'un chalet et tente roulotte disponible, toilettes et douche a l'entrée.

Des planches à voile et bateaux gonflables sont disponible. Le camping est en développement, le wifi est disponible seulement a l'entrée mais le lieu et l'ambiance y est magique!

quebec-established.name: Parc régional beauharnois
quebec-established.notes: Near a bike trail, boat ramp. Cost 20.00 per night

quebec-established.name: Oceanfront Campsite
quebec-established.notes: Campsite directly on the beach (at the end of the lovely town). There is a quiet road between. WiFi not free - extra charge even at fully serviced sites! Nice showers. Not cheap (first beach line CAD 54) - there are sites back for CAD 40. The sites are close together - okay for 1 night. No washroom access except for tenters or if requested in person.

quebec-established.name: Deer Lake RV Park and Campground
quebec-established.notes: Municipal camping of Deer Lake. On the shores of Deer Lake.

quebec-established.name: Camping Val Jalbert
quebec-established.notes:
Next to Ghost Town of Val Jalbert.
Many sites to accommodate all campers in tent or Class A motorhome.
price was 57$ Cdn. For all services including 50 amps.

quebec-established.name: camping lac eden
quebec-established.notes:
Small camping by the lake. 5$ with water. There is clean bathrooms and shower. A beach is just beside the camping also. 

There was big rig also with electricity but don't know the price.

quebec-established.name: Larocque Bridge St-Stanislas de Kostka
quebec-established.notes:
Picnic table, very quiet. It‘s supposed to be 20$ per night, use the drop box to pay. Close to boat ramp and bike trails. Beautiful view. Nice place to stay for one night.

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, In season, Les Régates Are authorized … the noise is therefore infernal in pm and at dinner time. We went to eat in town.

quebec-established.name: Berry Hill Campground (Gros Morne National Park)
quebec-established.notes: One of the 5 campground of Gros Morne National Park with a car access. Very crowded on summer.

quebec-established.name: Oasis Carignan
quebec-established.notes: Very nice place in the middle of a little forest, very nice and friendly hosts, currently space for only one RV (no tent camping), $15 Us no service and $20 us per night including 15 AMP and water, 20 km to Montreal, reservation required before arrival via telephone 450-447-6694 or by email patrickbonis@gmail.com.

quebec-established.name: camping a la ferme 5 étoiles
quebec-established.notes:
Camping with lots of animals (wolf bison doe farm animal sled dogs ...) mostly raised animals. Very nice place with children. Price about 50 dollars per night vr with full service and animal care with the guide
----
Camping avec plein d animaux (loup bison biche animaux de ferme chiens de traîneaux...) animaux recueillis pour la plupart. Endroit très sympa avec des enfants. Prix correct environ 50 dollars la nuit en vr avec full service et soin aux animaux avec la guide

quebec-established.name: Camping Du Ruisseau Rouge
quebec-established.notes: Nice and charming campground. Owners are very friendly and helpfull. Facilities are very clean. Unserviced spot 35,00 CND. Washingmachine and dryer available for 2,00 CND each. And... a small swimming pool.

quebec-established.name: Park Goodchild, Blanc Sablon
quebec-established.notes: It is a public campground (free!) and picnic area of the community, located at the eastern edge of the village at the foot of the hill, only minutes from the ferry terminal. About 7 grass sites along a paved road, generously spaced, with picnic tables, some with fire rings;  plenty of garbage cans, 1 pit toilet, 1 water faucet (non-potable) next to the entry sign. Turnaround space at end of road might be tight for very big rigs.

quebec-established.name: Bird Island Boat tour
quebec-established.notes:
Small campground run by the family that offer boat tour to the birds Island, where you can see puffins.
Quiet place
Laundry 
Dumpstation 
We had a good time on the boat.

quebec-established.name: Halte de la Belle-Étoile
quebec-established.notes:
municipal stop, at the edge of the water, quiet at night, bins and picnic tables are there.
---
halte municipale, au bord de l'eau, calme la nuit, poubelles et tables de pique-nique sont là. Autoriser pour 24 hrs par la municipalité

quebec-established.name: Plage Rouen Noranda
quebec-established.notes: a parking lot for RVs , 3 day maximum, picnic table, beach

quebec-established.name: Trout River Campground, Gros Morne NP
quebec-established.notes: Private with decent tree coverage between the sites. 2 warm showers in female and male washrooms. There’s a kitchen shelter. Close to the informative Discovery Centre and various hiking trails. $25.50/site.

quebec-established.name: Camping de la jolie Rochelle
quebec-established.notes: Very pretty campsite in St-Raphael de Bellechasse. Wooded land, some along the river, petanque and volley ball. Friendly and welcoming staff.

quebec-established.name: Zec Martin Valin Lac Barrette
quebec-established.notes:
Really tigh acces road for about 100 feet.
Nice park just at side of the lake.
You can fish with pré-inscription.
You have to pays access to zec and camping 10$ day. No service.

quebec-established.name: Arm of Gold
quebec-established.notes: Mostly for RVs but there is a nice grassed area for tents. Some spots covered, some only have a picnic table. $35 per night for tent, $.50 showers, good internet, kind hosts.

quebec-established.name: Station Uapishka
quebec-established.notes: Location of the new snd very modern Research center (they had to move up because of the water level raising) The surrounding (landscaping) is not done yet but the station is running, Rooms to rent and you can also camp there. More Infos at: www.stationuapishka.com

quebec-established.name: Halte Camping Lotbinière
quebec-established.notes:
Come and stay at the Halte camping Lotbinière!

25.01$ pour night plus 3.73$ reservation fee to be pain on line. no more limit on duration of stay.

By ONLINE reservation only, from the site www.reservationcamping.ca.
---
Venez séjourner à la Halte camping Lotbinière! 

Sur réservation EN LIGNE seulement, à partir du site www.reservationcamping.ca. 

25.01$ par nuit plus 3.73$ frais de reservation payable en ligne.  Aucune limite pour la durée du séjour.

quebec-established.name: Barrage des quinze iles
quebec-established.notes: Belle espace verte avec table picnic et toilette, eau non potable, avec vue sur le barrage. Parc pour enfant, ombragé. $15/nuit

quebec-established.name: Camping Lac Matagami
quebec-established.notes:
Excellent campground located on a magnificent lake.
Well maintained with all services.
Price for one day is $34 Canadian.

quebec-established.name: Mill Dam park
quebec-established.notes:
Nice park with Around 15 place for camping, camper or caravan.  Electricity, water, Child park and water game for child, pic-nic tables and restroom (no shower).  Really quiet and calm place.  
FREE CAMPING. Donation are accepted in a small box at the restroom.   It’s a public park, no personnel on the site. 

Near the bike path PPJ (piste cyclable du Pontiac)

quebec-established.name: Sandy Mountain Campsite
quebec-established.notes: Lovely, friendly wooded campsites with a pool, golf course, dumping and close to Kemptville and the nations capital, Ottawa

quebec-established.name: Motels Camping Des Flots Bleus
quebec-established.notes:
Small but charming campground.  You can also rent small cabin.
http://www.flotsbleus.ca/

quebec-established.name: Land of Evangeline Camping Resort
quebec-established.notes: Big campground, family. Pool lots of seasonal campers, few places available. This is not wild camping. Paid showers.

quebec-established.name: Old Shipyard Beach Campground
quebec-established.notes: Great, just in front of the water. Ring for campfires. Perfect.

quebec-established.name: Camping Municipal Brownsburg-Chatham
quebec-established.notes:
Nice campground along Outaouais river. 
Possible to stay for the night only without services in the parking lot for $10.

quebec-established.name: Excursions du Phare
quebec-established.notes: Campground on the beach. 20$ no hookups, 25 with. you can take a tour of iles nue, iles du phare and grande ile from here. 65$ for the first 2 and 105$ for all 3. we loved the excursion and would recommend it. lots of whales can be seen from the beach.

quebec-established.name: Lakeside
quebec-established.notes:
A nice free place. There are several places for big caravans, there is a landing stage to access the lake, there is a big gazebo and several campfires. The corporation that has built the site however there is no water and sewer or electricity.

Un bel endroit gratuit aménager .
Il y a plusieurs emplacements pour de grandes roulotte il y a un débarcadère pour accéder au lac il y a un grand Gazebos et plusieurs feu de camp.
C’est une corporation qui ont aménagé le site cependant il y a pas d’eau et d’égoût ni électricité.

SVP offrez un don, il y a un endroit prévu à cette fin. Faisons en sorte que la corporation soient encline à garder cet endroit accessible aux vanlife.

quebec-established.name: campground Le Saumonois
quebec-established.notes: A really nice campground with around 20 sites and much space for tents.We were the only ones this night. Fireplace available. With 2 services 30$, Without services 15 $. great campground with water sport: eg stand-up paddling

quebec-established.name: Camping du lac
quebec-established.notes: Nice simple camping in a very big parc in « Lac au Saumon ». 15$ per night for tent. Clean bathroom, water and electricity seems to be available. Also an public place so you can stop for bathroom or water freely. Water play for kids and large playground on site.

quebec-established.name: Brudenell Provincial Campground
quebec-established.notes:
Nice shower and bathroom facilities.

Standard Provincial park.

Came to just over 40$ with taxes so not cheap but sites are large and quite private. All have fire pits etc.

Wifi available as long as you’re near the registration desk.

quebec-established.name: JT Cheeseman Provincial Park
quebec-established.notes:
Great place for before or after the ferry. If they are closed, go in and choose a site and pay in the morning. Water, showers, flush toilets, and dry toilets. WiFi at the rangers house. Nice walk to the beach and a 4 x 4 track to the point. 
Tent $20.15 Electric $30.90 day pass $10. If you have the yearly Labrador pass, it is included. Nice park with wind protection and lots of privacy. About 30 minutes to the ferry dock.

quebec-established.name: Pokemouche Camping
quebec-established.notes: Nice camping with good sites with waterview. Public restrooms are clean, laundry room ($), pool, canteen ($), little marina, nice kid playgroung and a kid waterpark($).

quebec-established.name: Cedar Dunes Provincial Park
quebec-established.notes: Quiet campground directly at the beach. A few 100 meters to little harbor where you can get lobsters literally directly off the boat. Clean services. Recommended.

quebec-established.name: Broadleaf ranch
quebec-established.notes: Ranch with camping and rv sites fully serviced. Wifi, playground, free washing machine and 1$ dryer. Restaurant. Well-maintained, dog friendly and very nice staff. Short drive to national park, cap enragé and Hopewell rocks. Offers horseback riding, some trails, swimming pond, cabins and glamping units.

quebec-established.name: Camping Côte Surprise
quebec-established.notes: This is a camping that is well located with a very good view of the Rocher Percé and l'île Bonaventure. Free shower and laundry machine.

quebec-established.name: Parc national d'Opémican
quebec-established.notes: Provincial park.  Very beautifull but you can see the other cam site around you.

quebec-established.name: Parc National de la Yamaska
quebec-established.notes: Nice family campground; bike paths, lake with beach. Publicly owned and operated by Sepaq.

quebec-established.name: Hyclass Ocean Campground
quebec-established.notes: Campground on the ocean with serviced and unserviced sites. Showers($), Laundry($), flush toilets.

quebec-established.name: Camping de la Diable
quebec-established.notes:
expensive for electrical hook up @ $55. Laundry, swimming pool, games room. tenting sites for $45. good location to bike from. On side of river which would be great in good weather.  Some nice sites by river, others like a parking lot. 
worked for us to catch up on wi Fi and wash clothes.

quebec-established.name: Hartt Island
quebec-established.notes: Campground with a lot of sites river front. Clean, quiet but Hwy passing near a bit noisy. Waterpark is just wow and the mini putt is fun (included when on site)

quebec-established.name: Camping du Quai, Riviere du Loups
quebec-established.notes:
This campground has good rates as they offer a sites with only 15 amp electricity or no service if you like.
Typical commercial campground sites somewhat crowded, but most have grass which is nice.
 Washer and dryer are cheap. Showers cramped, but hot water good.

quebec-established.name: Glooscap Park Campground
quebec-established.notes: Campground with ocean views and beach access. Really nice view. Site for small rv with power and water was 35$. Some pull through sites and some seasonal campers, dump station. They sell good firewood for reasonable price and their ice is the usual size bag but really large chunks that lasted longer in the cooler than the smaller cubes.  Clean pit toilets and coin showers, $1 for 5 minutes. Near Parrsboro, a town with a good bakery and brewery, a few restaurants, antique store,  grocery store and a theatre company. This is a well known fossil and gem area, great fossil museum in the town.

quebec-established.name: Cavendish KOA
quebec-established.notes:
Grassy spots and nice bathroom and laundry. friendly staff.
Good place to clean up and restock. The staff were careful to space out campers since the place is half empty which was nice. 
you can choose only 2 services and 15 amp plug to save $. about $40 for spot.

quebec-established.name: Fairview Park
quebec-established.notes: Nice little campground with tent sites, full hookup, flush toilets, showers... Not busy at this time so lot of space but might be busy in summer with not lot of privacy. Lovely river in the middle. 33$ for a tent site without water and electricity.

quebec-established.name: MacLeod’s  Beach & Campsite
quebec-established.notes:
Beautiful property! I didn’t stay the night but a road sign said they had showers. He initially said $5 for a shower because he thought I was part of a group, but didn’t charge me when he realized it was just one person. Showers were clean and hot! Definitely worth $5 in my opinion :)

 902-258-2433

quebec-established.name: Corney Brook Campsite
quebec-established.notes:
Corney Brook / Rivière à Lazare
Small self-registration campsite next to a nice beach. Basic facilities -Washrooms, shelter, dishwashing sinks, potable water, picnic tables, and fire pits but no showers.

quebec-established.name: Lake Waswanipi
quebec-established.notes:
An 8 km gravel road from Highway 113 brings you to this beautiful place. There is a sandy beach with a boat launch, pit toilets, firepits and picnictables.
It's 5$ for a night.

quebec-established.name: Saint-Godefroi
quebec-established.notes: Municipal small campground by the beach and marina. Picnic tables, Non potable water, toilets on upper site. Can hear the road but private.

quebec-established.name: Rivère à la pèche
quebec-established.notes: The best campground we have seen travelling across Canada + Alaska. Perfect sanitary ammenities: private showers perfectly clean at no extra cost.  An additional kitchen shelter - ideal for tent travellers with wood fireplace, sink with warm water. The cost for RV with no electricity $25,50.

quebec-established.name: Baddeck Cabot Trail campground

Grassy area to camp/park on but riveted with back-hoe holes or piled up with slash to deter you. There was a fire-pit on the right away from trees (back-ho operator pilfers soil here). Some noise from ferry workers and arriving vehicles but it is not objectionable. PEI Visitor Center up the road might be better if you want a quieter spot.
At the ferry terminal, there's Wi-Fi (not fast), outdoor water tap, some outlets to plug in portables, dog park, and sorting receptacles for recycling and compost. In season, there may be an open snack place at the harbor fishing pier. Beware of mosquitoes and no bathroom access after the terminal closes.

Veuillez retirer de votre site Web tous les sites de camping non spécifiés de l'île d'Orléans "

quebec-informal.name: Mont Sutton, parking lot : P2C
quebec-informal.notes:
MODERATOR NOTE: Description provided by owner or manager.  

Location: Parking Lots P2C and P3B: Open May 15th to October 31st
 
No services: No water, electricity, toilet, shower or picnic table… you are outdoors and must be fully self-sufficient.
 
Fees: As a season opening special and for the time being, there are no fees. Rates to come shortly. Stay tuned.
 
Rules to follow to guarantee the sustainability of this great opportunity:
 
Although somewhat distant from residential areas, we ask that you be mindful. Sound carries easily in the mountains and other campers might not appreciate the disturbance. Obviously, mutual respect is paramount between users, the mountain staff and the community.
 
There is no tent camping allowed at the base of the mountain and fires are not permitted. Rustic camping for tents is located at the top of the mountain and by reservation only.
 
We ask that you park in such a way as to minimize the space occupied in the parking lots, so that a maximum number of users can be accommodated by day and night. All types of recreational vehicles are accepted but you must be self-sufficient and pack out everything you bring. There are no garbage or recycling containers for your waste. Please make sure to keep the area clean, hence maintaining the right of access to the grounds.
 
Finally, please respect the covid rules in effect. No gatherings will be allowed.
 
If you have any questions, please write us at sutton@montsutton.com.

In winter, the same conditions apply.

quebec-informal.name: Municipal Carpark
quebec-informal.notes: Large carpark in front of the cruise ship pier and beside the PEI Urban Indigenous Centre which has its own small parking lot (do not park there). Go to the large, paved municipal lot next to it. Will be busy during the day but quiet after 9 pm. No frills, good cell service on Bell. Short walk to downtown for bars/restaurants etc. Access to toilets during the day at the nearby food market.  Receiver Coffee Shop is nearby. Good for a night right downtown near the harbor.

quebec-informal.name: Island Wesleyan Church
quebec-informal.notes: A place to park over night. Probably not Sunday

quebec-informal.name: Celtic shores coastal trail 2
quebec-informal.notes:
kiosk covers a picnic table with two other tables available, make right turn onto the trail used by atv to hikers, about 200m to site. Level clear site and kept well by volunteers. no posting about what is not permitted. 
overlooks Harbour, beach and a spectacular sunset.

quebec-informal.name: victoriaville
quebec-informal.notes:
5 RVs allowed, one night.

quebec-informal.name: Picnic area
quebec-informal.notes: Picnic area, a spot along the road 117, on the border of Reservoir Dozois, quiet just at night because big trucks during the day, place to swim and lunch, pit toilets.

quebec-informal.notes: I normally park here whenever I'm in Sydney, it's quiet at night, and most morning except some weekends. 2 pit toilets and nice trails with views overlook the water. Big gravel parking, so big rigs friendly.

Reviews were on Park4Night app.  Trash and recycling bins available.  View of the water and stairs going down to the river.  Beautiful sunset!

quebec-informal.name: Side road off of cemetery
quebec-informal.notes: Nice ocean view spot for the night. Road not too bad. Grassy area

quebec-informal.name: L’Isle Verte
quebec-informal.notes:
Amazing spot with small playground, trails , fresh water, dump and toilets. Municipality-run. Very welcoming, including an information booth of local interests. Very hospitable!

Note: Toilets are not always open.

Toilet (clean) nearby as well as a drinking trough. Water games nearby.

quebec-informal.name: Truck Stop on Highway 10 at Magog
quebec-informal.notes: Large truck stop parking lot beside gas station, Subway, A&W and Tim Hortons with a tourist information office.  RVs are permitted in the front row with the back row reserved for the large commercial trucks.  A bit noisy.

quebec-informal.name: Bay St-Laurence
quebec-informal.notes:
180• view of the ocean. Great spot for one van 4x4 ideally. Someone cut the grass and left a lobster cage as a table. No private 'do not enter' sign.  Spent the night. no problem. No one around.
.....

quebec-informal.name: $20/night. This is a lot across the road from Marcel Gagnon Gallery and Marcel Gagnon Gallery and Restaurant
quebec-informal.notes: $20/night. A lot across the street from the Marcel Gagnon Gallery and Restaurant. There is a washroom that is locked at night. Check-in at the gift shop in the Gallery. They offer a key for the washroom and free wifi. The restaurant food is quite good, and the sunset amazing.

quebec-informal.name: Walmart
quebec-informal.notes: A smaller Walmart shop but still lots of parking. stayed the night with 4 other vans without issue.

quebec-informal.name: River Hebert Tidle Bore Park
quebec-informal.notes: 4 sites with shelter and picnic tables, waste bins each , outhouse but next to the road, very quite though

quebec-informal.name: Accueil Réserve Portneuf (SEPAQ)
quebec-informal.notes:
Large parking lot, near a lake. 3 small hidden sites to go and make a fire there. Quiet
---------------

quebec-informal.name: Sussex Park
quebec-informal.notes: Large parking lot at the entrance to a few walking trails and a disc golf circuit. Bit of road noise and not overly scenic, but had cell service (Telus/AT&T) and a portapotty. Please be respectful here as it’s clearly a popular spot for local dog walks, so not a long term stay, but overall great place to spend a night!

quebec-informal.name: Matane ferry terminal
quebec-informal.notes: Parked here overnight for the 8AM ferry to Godbout Quebec. lots of room in lot, level, cleared with staff.

quebec-informal.name: Parc de la Paix
quebec-informal.notes:
We stopped here to sleep. Beautiful spot with breathtaking sunrise. Small trail to go down to the river. Belvedere. A little noisy because of the road.
.....
Nous sommes arrêtés ici pour dormir,

quebec-informal.name: Halte de Kamouraska,
quebec-informal.notes: Provincial rest stop along  TransCanada (westbound), past Riviere du Loop, paved parking lot, well lit, several picnic tables and mini gazebos on grassy area with trees, payphones, washrooms/running water

quebec-informal.name: Belvedere Mine Lookout Parking
quebec-informal.notes: parking for the Belvedere Mine Lookout. sign says 48h for cars 24h for trucks. nothing great but should be ok to park here overnight and would probably be quiet

quebec-informal.name: Waterfront Park
quebec-informal.notes: Parking on the west river, there's a tourist information booth with washrooms open during the day. We didn't see any signs forbidding overnight parking. There's a mechanic shop across the street so it's a bit noisy in the morning. The east side of the river has parallel parking so could fit longer rigs and trailers, but we didn't check for signs there.

quebec-informal.name: Victoria Mall

There’s a shopping Mall , almost closed, big parking.
This is close to the Petawawa Point beach.
No signs of time limit or overnight parking. Very quiet.

quebec-informal.name: Le Village Beauceron
quebec-informal.notes:
City sponsored Historical re-enactment site

The Village Beauceron is a historic village and a rest area of ​​the Municipality of St-Prosper.
 The rest area is open 24 hours a day, year round.  No RV size limit, but no camping.  Toilets and drinking fountains but no water or electrical outlets.  Parking (free) for 7 days.  Wifi, picnic tables.  Very nice site.  A bit noisy early in the morning due to traffic.

---
Le Village Beauceron est un village historique et une halte routière de la Municipalité de St-Prosper.
La halte routière est ouverte a l’année longue 24/24. Pas de limite de grandeur de VR, mais pas de camping. Toilettes et abreuvoirs mais pas de prise d’eau, ni prises électriques. Stationnement (gratuit) permis de 7 jours. Wifi, tables de picnic. Très beau site. Un peu  bruyant tôt le matin du au traffic.

quebec-informal.name: Wolfville
quebec-informal.notes:
Right in downtown Wolfville. The sign at the front says:
All Day Parking. Overnight Parking Permitted
Owner assumes all risk. Until further notice

Two Sprinters and a small tear drop trailer spent the nigh,t no problem.  Lots of other cars parked overnight.  Very quiet against the Bay and there is a lovely walking path, dogs allowed on leash.
We all had our windows open, but lights were off and all campers remained low-key.  I didn’t see a bathroom anywhere, but we have our own.  Please remain self-contained and do not come here if you cannot fit within a regular parking spot.

That means that if you use a generator, put out slides, set up chairs outside:  go to the nearby Walmart so you don’t ruin it for everyone else.

quebec-informal.name: brudenell provincial park
quebec-informal.notes: Just at the entrance to the road leading to the campsite, an asphalted area that can accommodate several RVs and motorized vehicles. no location was available on the campsite and we asked if it was possible to park there, we were confirmed that it was possible. The cellular network is weak. Less than 100m from the secondary road, but very quiet for the night.

quebec-informal.name: Parking incitatif - Granby
quebec-informal.notes: A parking area to encourage carpooling which can easily involve about fifty vehicles. In two nights we were not disturbed. Near to a station gas and a Tim Horton!

quebec-informal.name: Beachside spot

Picnic Tables and garbage can.

quebec-informal.name: Hartland Bridge Parking
quebec-informal.notes:
No signs disallowing overnight parking.
Beautiful sunset view.
Picnic tables.
Grocery and pizza across the street.
A few noisy dirt bike riders.

Français
Petite halte routière en bord de route avec toilettes et tables. Peu de trafic la nuit.

quebec-informal.name: Goose Bay Wharf
quebec-informal.notes: Great place in boatyard/wharf area. Make sure to not park in boat launch area. Will park alongside vehicles with boat trailers and big boats on trailers. Popular with locals to come and park by lake Melville. Quiet at night. Breezy, so no bugs.

quebec-informal.name: Walmart Superstore - Kemptville
quebec-informal.notes: Spoke with the manager on duty, they allow overnight parking for RVs and trailers. Overnight Guest are required to park in front of the store at the end of the parking lot as per the MOD. Washrooms are available from open till close and there is also a McDonald’s at this location with in the store. There’s also a beer store, liquor store, staples, marks, Canadian tire, Dairy Queen, Starbucks and a few different restaurants all within walking distance.

quebec-informal.name: Stationnement Municipal Du Moulin
quebec-informal.notes:
Municipal parking lot. $20 for the night with an area for RV. Within walking distance of the municipal beach, restaurants and bike paths. Toilet at the beach (2 min) and outdoor shower.

Stationnement municipal payant 20$ pour la nuit avec une zone pour VR. A distance de marche de la plage municipale, des resto et des pistes cyclables. Toilette a la plage (2 min) et douche extérieur.

quebec-informal.name: Miramichi, NB
quebec-informal.notes: Nice paved, flat parking lot just above the marina. A former park, recommended by a local, who said it is OK. View of water.

quebec-informal.name: Algonquin Highlands municipal Office and Museum
quebec-informal.notes: A large paved parking lot between the museum and municipal office.  we pulled to the back of the lot and we're not bothered.  potable water source at office.  suitable for large units.  Excellent cell phone service.

quebec-informal.name: Bracebridge Agricultural Society Fairgrounds
quebec-informal.notes: We have stayed at this fairgrounds twice now (spring and summer) with no issues at all.  Right off highway 11.  Level parking lot with lots of room for big rigs.  A pioneer village on site makes a nice walk.  Check for events.

quebec-informal.name: East Bay

quebec-informal.name: Wabush water aérodrome park
quebec-informal.notes: Large level parking on gravel. View on the lake amd one trash bin. We’re two rigs and had quiet night. Locals come and go in the evening.

quebec-informal.name: Parking lot

Parking lot between the church, museum and Morrison's restaurant. no sign that overnight parking is forbidden. washrooms close by at the museum.

I can recommend Morrison's restaurant as well!

quebec-informal.name: Margaret Bowater Park
quebec-informal.notes: I have parked here for 2 nights on the row.  Beautiful park with many nice trails. There's also a public washroom nearby. On the first night, a police car drove in and out, didn't say anything. It's quite chill here. I haven't got to finished all the trails. There's another small car park on the other side of the street.

quebec-informal.name: Plage Ideale

quebec-informal.notes: parking lot walmart close to hwy 20 but very quiet.About 10 rv/camper right in town of st-hyacinte.No sign of no parking for the night but onethat said no long term parking. we were not disturb.

quebec-informal.name: Chute de Risseau Creux
quebec-informal.notes: No no camping sign at this trail head. Quiet and peaceful and the hike was beautiful!

quebec-informal.name: la baleine endiablée

quebec-informal.name: Base Plein Air Sainte-Foy
quebec-informal.notes: Large lot. Quiet. Water station is 24 hrs. Toilet WC is open 24/7, WC with shower is open from 9am to 9pm.

quebec-informal.name: Public parking lot on Rue John Nairne
quebec-informal.notes: Free public car park with no charge and without no camping signs. It's on a quiet mix-use street (there are businesses and flats) so it's mostly quiet except there is an industrial dry cleaning company and trucks came in to loaf/unload around 9pm and then at 7am. There are 8 vehicles parked overnight, but we're the only vanlife.

quebec-informal.name: Walmart Vaudreuil-Dorion
quebec-informal.notes:
There are no "no parking" signs here. We spent a quiet night along with over 30 cars (why are cars always parked at Wal-Mart?), there were 3 semi-trucks and two other campers. One of the semis left around midnight and caused some noise but otherwise super quiet. 

There's wifi signals from Wal-Mart and Reno Depot. Both relatively strong.

Take care and good luck.

quebec-informal.name: Kahnawake Brewery
quebec-informal.notes: A parking lot good for all size RVs, in front of the brewery. After a couple glasses of beer, we asked if OK to park overnight. The staffs were happy to agree. After more beer, we had a nice sleep there. it is close to highway, a little noisy, but not too much in night.

quebec-informal.name: Manoir Mauvide-Genest
quebec-informal.notes:
suggested donation 20$ to camp here.
Interact paiement accepted.
Visit the manoir for 10$. Very interesting, it is open 10th of October

quebec-informal.name: Les Digue
quebec-informal.notes: A few spots on a flat grassy field with picnic tables. Talk to the owners of the local grocer before setting up camp. For self contained only.

quebec-informal.name: Centre 200
quebec-informal.notes: We took in a show at Centre 200 and we and other overlanders and RVs were permitted to stay overnight in the parking lot for the centre.  No services available and not suitable for ground tents.

quebec-informal.name: Parking Lot of Pavillon St- Arnaud
quebec-informal.notes:
This parking lot is next door the a beautiful park ( Parc Pie Xii) that had two nice water features, beach volleyball courts, basketball hoops and lots of green space and picnic tables to use. 
There’s a red portapotty near the baseball diamond and lots of garbage cans around. The bonus is there are flush toilets in the small white building beside the basketball hoops!  
These bathrooms get locked up at night but the portapotty is left open. 
We stayed here two nights without any issue at all but I would suggest no more than one or two vehicles could stay here overnight without drawing attention. 
It’s a beautiful park, please keep it that way by taking care of your garbage etc!

quebec-informal.name: Walmart Cowansville
quebec-informal.notes: Large parking in commercial zone, quiet place. We were authorized to stay a night.

quebec-informal.name: Irving Big Stop
quebec-informal.notes: Truck stop right before the causeway. Fairly noisy at night, but easy access and facilities.

quebec-informal.name: Public parking near Microbrasserie
quebec-informal.notes:
Public parking, no sign saying overnight parking is forbidden. Residential area is quite close, so I think this is no space for many campers at the same time.

I can highly recommend the microbrewery Ayawan close by!

quebec-informal.name: Cape george lighthouse
quebec-informal.notes: Parked here for the night. Amazing sunrise.... Absolutely quiet except super windy... Found a very level spot on the gravel

quebec-informal.name: Irving Drivers Lounge
quebec-informal.notes: I saw this location was marked previously, however I thought that I would make a new post and add that it is a full driver's lounge and the parking lot is massive! Safe to say Irving is our favorite Fuel or rest stop in Canada. Very clean , Large showers , Laundry , Wine and Beer store , snacks and all roadside vehicles necessities.  A&W as well ( Closed Sundays ).  We parked at the far outside of the lot to keep our trailer out of sight for the evening but didn't hear anyone close through the night, just traffic in the distance

quebec-informal.name: Stationnement Municipal Orford

On a garé ici deux nuits, pas de problemme, mais il faut payer apres 9h, et apres midi c’est un arrêt de bus- lis les panneaux. (Desolé pour français mauvais.)

quebec-informal.name: P2 parc de la montagne du diable

Stationnement P2 du parc. Aucun affichage interdisant la nuit sur le stationnement; droit d’accès au parc 8$ par personne . Accueil ouvert 24/7, avec toilettes, douches, cuisine, salle de rencontre. Parfait!

quebec-informal.name: Thierry’s House

Free overnight parking, wifi, couch/inflatable mattress, shower, etc. 2 minute walk from Main Street.

Paying it forward for other travelers! 

Email me at: thierry.gaudreau@gmail.com

quebec-informal.name: Grand Tracadie Ball Field Parkinglot

You will have free potable water, electricity and wifi.

quebec-informal.name: Halte VR Ste-Marie
quebec-informal.notes:
MODERATOR NOTE: Place added by owner/ manager.

The City of Sainte-Marie is proud to announce the upcoming opening of its Halte VR located at 883, rue Notre-Dame Nord, near the Parc Nautique Saputo.

The Halte VR Sainte-Marie has 19 sites and offers access to drinking water and a dump station as amenities. This space now allows travelers in transit to take a break between two destinations and, by the same token, discover tourist attractions and take advantage of the many services offered by our beautiful city.

At a daily cost of $25 (taxes included), travelers can stay for a maximum of three nights. No reservations will be taken in advance, the principle of first come, first served applies. The payment, as well as the reservation of the location are made on site using a parking meter located at the entrance to the site.
________________

La Halte VR will be in operation from May 19 to October 9, 2023.
La Ville de Sainte-Marie est fière de vous annoncer l’ouverture prochaine de sa Halte VR située au 883, rue Notre-Dame Nord, près du Parc Nautique Saputo.

La Halte VR Sainte-Marie comprend 19 emplacements et offre comme commodités l’accès à de l’eau potable, ainsi qu’à une station de vidange.  Cet espace permet maintenant aux voyageurs en transit de prendre un peu de répit entre deux destinations et, par le fait même, de découvrir les attraits touristiques et de profiter des nombreux services qu’offrent notre belle ville.

Au coût journalier de 25 $ (taxes incluses), les voyageurs pourront séjourner pendant un maximum de trois nuitées. Aucune réservation ne sera prise à l’avance, le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi s’applique. Le paiement, ainsi que la réservation de l’emplacement sont effectués sur place à l’aide d’un horodateur situé à l’entrée du site.

La Halte VR sera en opération du 19 mai au 9 octobre 2023.
