quebec-wild.name: Gull Cove Trailhead
quebec-wild.notes: Parking at trailhead.  Suitable for one night. Next to cemetery. A trash can for the hike is available, no other amenities.

quebec-wild.name: Gravel turn in on forest rd
quebec-wild.notes: Gravel turn in on the forest rd. Gravel / rock road. Should be fine for 2wd. No facilities.

quebec-wild.name: Backroad camp spot
quebec-wild.notes: Pull in off a corner. Room for one vehicle. Fire pit. No facilities. Nearby river, but no access.

quebec-wild.name: Roadside south of St. Pauls
quebec-wild.notes: Pullout just off the highway between St. Pauls and the park boundary. A great view of the ocean and sunset.

quebec-wild.name: Residential street
quebec-wild.notes:
Relatively quiet residential street. There's a park and river on one side and a very popular market and grocery stores within walking distance. 
Only restriction on this particular street is no a parking on Wednesday mornings but there's a few other streets around that have different restrictions. 
Spots seem to fill up around 5pm with people coming home from work but if you can get here earlier, there's no time restrictions on parking and it's a great location. 
There are toilets near the ice cream shop at atwater markets. No services.

quebec-wild.name: Simpson Lake
quebec-wild.notes: Located in Collingwood, NS, approx. 1.2 km off Wyvern road (snowmobile trail) you will find two sites right on the water on Simpson Lake. The first is very open, the second more secluded (we chose the second). This is on a major atv / snowmobile trail and we did have some atv traffic during the evening. It is not accessible by vehicle in the winter. There is a large firepit at the water's edge and you can easily launch a kayak / canoe here.

quebec-wild.name: Pull off on local service road
quebec-wild.notes: Quiet pull off down the local service road. High clearance recommenced. Possible 4x4 if it’s wet and muddy.  Few km’s down the service road until you find a spot you can pull off the road.  Nice views across to the table lands.

quebec-wild.name: Moose River
quebec-wild.notes:
Road beside bridge over Moose River leads down to two areas. Upper bench is flat and large. Lower bench is right on the river. Beautiful spot for the night. River site can be seen by people crossing the bridge, but you are still 50meters from the bridge. Camper van or truck and camper no problem on the river.  Larger vehicles no problem on upper bench.

9km east of Parrsboro on the Glooscap Trail Road

quebec-wild.name: Churchill Falls Generating Station
quebec-wild.notes: Parking lot at end of road, next to Churchill River. Beautiful view of river, and short trail to view of tail races. No signs prohibiting overnight parking or camping. Nice grassy picnic area with small  screened gazebo, 3 outside picnic tables, 2 benches. Looks like a larger gazebo is being built.  Boat ramp, as well as wooden staircase down to river and dock. 2-3 bars 4G reception! As usual, lots of black flies and mosquitos, unless there is a breeze.

quebec-wild.name: Bird Sanctuary
quebec-wild.notes: Nice place for small rig, quiet please respect the area since this is a bird sanctuary

quebec-wild.name: Road entrance to a few camping spots
quebec-wild.notes:
Three very nice and quiet wild camping spots, all within 850 meters from the entrance.
The nearest one is large enough for big rigs.
There are two other spots down the road that are on the river side, you should walk to take a look before you go in there with a trailer.

quebec-wild.name: St Eustache parking lot
quebec-wild.notes: a very big parking where you can stay to go to downtown with the bus go the Momorency métro station. Quiet at night close to the movie screen

quebec-wild.name: Belvédère municipal Ferland et Boileau
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice gazebo with garbage cans and dry toilets (closed season hous). We hear the murmur of the creek nearby and unfortunately a vehicle passing on the road. Fortunately there is little traffic on this road at night.

Jolie belvédère avec poubelles et toilettes sèches (fermées hous saison). O n entend le murmure du ruisseau à proximité et malheureusement un véhicule qui passe sur la route. Heureusement il y a peu de circulation sur cette route la nuit

quebec-wild.name: dirt road leading to grassy area (high clearance recommended)
quebec-wild.notes:
dirt road leading to a grassy area next to a beach(not the nicest beach as lots of seaweed when we were there), quiet and good for the night. looks like it's used by locals judging by the fire ring marks on the grass.  
Data is available but not wifi

quebec-wild.name: old ferry departure site
quebec-wild.notes: This is a dead end street. Its the site of an old ferry to a local island. So it has a large flat parking area. No houses near by. It would be hard to turn a big trailer around but a class b or c  would be fine.

quebec-wild.name: Black Beach
quebec-wild.notes: Beach parking lot down a gravel road. No signs. Remains of fire pits and some trash from visitors. Also a trailhead so cars in the day. Nice black sand beach. Great for van or small RV. Great scenery and lighthouse if you walk the trail (about 1 km) from the fence just before arriving to the beach. Bring your camera!

quebec-wild.name: Forest field
quebec-wild.notes: Place for one night, 200m-300m. from 17hw, nice for night, little noisy, but no signs no overnight camping.

quebec-wild.name: Old road
quebec-wild.notes: Near road but out of rock, not noisy at night, no signs.

quebec-wild.name: Lake Petit Bras
quebec-wild.notes: Nice silent place, lake beach, nice view, no signs, 2km from 138road and city. Network 4g. Road some where with rocks, be carefull.

quebec-wild.name: I'Anse Pleureuse river
quebec-wild.notes: 100m from198 road, on high voltage  line, near river. Fireplace and a lot of firewood in forest. Silent at night.

quebec-wild.name: Forest road
quebec-wild.notes: Very silent and quiet place, perfect for night, fireplace, lot firewood..

quebec-wild.name: Gravel quarry
quebec-wild.notes: Unused place, many places to stay, fireplace, silent at night

quebec-wild.name: 2 river
quebec-wild.notes: Only 4x4 car, dirty road, nice place, beach river. 2021- Wouldn't recommend unless you have tools to clear the road as it is grown in.

quebec-wild.name: Forest field
quebec-wild.notes: Not big place, for 2 Rv or 1 big rig, in the middle of the forest, silent at night, no signs, nice forest, 4g network

quebec-wild.name: Halte des Horizons
quebec-wild.notes: Municipal rest area at a high point with a nice view. Incredible free wireless internet access! Great view. On the road, but little traffic.

quebec-wild.name: Montreal streets
quebec-wild.notes: parking 24 hrs is legal in Montrèal. Just observe the permit only, and no parking signs. A great way to crash for a night .

quebec-wild.name: Newfoundland
quebec-wild.notes: Looks great no signs need 4x4 to get in wide open space right on ocean

quebec-wild.name: Logging Road
quebec-wild.notes: wild. not far from hwy28.  no facilities. quiet

quebec-wild.name: Roadside pullout on Richelieu River
quebec-wild.notes: Nice spot on the side of the road in front of the river. No sign. People often come to fish. I stayed here one night with a camper van. There is only space for one or two small campers.

quebec-wild.name: Old boat ramp
quebec-wild.notes: This is a beautiful spot. There's room for several RVs, or tent. You wouldn't want to bring a big rig down here.

quebec-wild.name: Maces Bay
quebec-wild.notes: Beautiful quiet spot to camp. Waiting for the sunset. Wild camping at its finest.

quebec-wild.name: Maison de la Faune
quebec-wild.notes: Quiet parking on the bank of the Manicouagan River. Small boat launching ramp. Access via a gravel road behind the wildlife house.

quebec-wild.name: Advocate Harbour parking area
quebec-wild.notes: A small parking area by the beach, no signs anywhere.  Some people come and go to take their dogs for a walk.  It got very quiet after dusk, and quiet all night long.

quebec-wild.name: Houston's Beach
quebec-wild.notes: At the end of Stuart Mountain Road there is a small parking area and a beautiful beach.  There were not any 'no overnight parking' signs anywhere.  There were a couple other vans that stayed overnight as well.  The sunset was beautiful!

quebec-wild.name: Parking lot near the woods
quebec-wild.notes: Big parking at near a hamlock wood trail. Space enough for everyone. Short gravelroad to drive. Very quiet. Natural  Springs in the wood. Nice trail to walk

quebec-wild.name: Jacks Lakes
quebec-wild.notes: it looks like a boat launch area, no visible sign of no parking or no camping.

quebec-wild.name: carrière / quarry
quebec-wild.notes:
Open site, near trees. Fire pits.
Terrain is pretty leveled and accessible. Not so much for a big rig I would imagine.
Pretty quiet at night, but there was people with quads and guns nearby after supper.
On the other side of the bridge on the main road, the is another spot by the river.

quebec-wild.name: Petite chute àl’ours
quebec-wild.notes:
Gravel parking lot slightly away from the road. Departure of a small path towards the fall. Quiet night despite the road. Nice fall.

FRENCH
Stationnement en gravier légèrement à l’écart de la route. Départ d’un petit sentier vers la chute.  Nuit tranquille malgré la route. Belle chute

quebec-wild.name: Small forest glade
quebec-wild.notes:
Small forest glade near gravel road. The place isn’t in the provincial park. Keep your eyes pealed we saw Wolfs at evening.
Hidden

quebec-wild.name: Economy River Falls Trailhead
quebec-wild.notes: Excellent spot for smaller vehicles (vans, truck campers), nothing in tow. Awesome hike to some wonderful waterfalls.  Very quiet location for an overnight stay.  Rough road coming in.

quebec-wild.name: Grandpa's Nose
quebec-wild.notes:
Sand pit area, room for a few vehicles, maybe a couple trailers. Great spot for campfires, hidden from the road.
Adventure sports paradise, Surfing at the beach, climbing on the cliff, and white water kayaking or canoeing on the river.

Pro tips:
-Go take a hike up that cliff in the back! You will have an insane view of the entire region and ocean.
-Go take a walk down the little atv trail, then follow the sounds of the river through the woods. Great little spot.

quebec-wild.name: Off road
quebec-wild.notes: A clearing on the forest car off the road. Very quiet, no traffic, and cars can't see you from the road. There is an bit of rubbish scattered around but but too bad. Decent mobile signal on PublicMobile.

quebec-wild.name: Creepy Camp
quebec-wild.notes:
Isolated place of the world just the song of the birds and some cries of animals, at the edge of the water.
Right next to an abandoned chalet

FRANCAIS
Endroit isolé du monde juste le chant des oiseaux et quelques cris d'animaux, au bord de l'eau.
Juste à coté d'un chalet abandonné.

quebec-wild.name: Descente bateau st damase
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice little parc in front of the river.
quiet. no problem

quebec-wild.name: Menet lake
quebec-wild.notes: Great site, lakeshore is approximately 30 feet from camp site.  Final approach requires decent clearance, I was fine in a stock xterra.  There is space to leave a car before the turn into the site, and then carry your tent/gear to the site, which is approximately 50 feet away.  I’ve tried to show the rocks and pull out space in the photos.  Lots of mosquitos.

quebec-wild.name: Chedabucta Bay Look Out Point
quebec-wild.notes: A massive car park for the look out point. There are no no camping signs. The view is stunning. No services but good cell signal on PublicMobile.

quebec-wild.name: Mont-Édouard
quebec-wild.notes:
Mont-Edouard parking lot. near hiking and mountain bike spots. level toilets / showers / access to drinking water, available in winter. summer, I don't know


parking du Mont-Édouard. près de hiking et de spot de mountain bike. niveau toilettes/douches/accès à l'eau potable, dispo en hiver. l'été, I don't know.

quebec-wild.name: Grand-Calumet
quebec-wild.notes: By the river near the boat ramp.  Quiet spot.  Stayed overnight.

quebec-wild.name: Near Jardin de Métis
quebec-wild.notes: Basically go to where the Métis river flows into the sea ! there's a gravel parking lot, a beautiful beach and no signs that prohibit parking

quebec-wild.name: Abandoned Sports Terrain
quebec-wild.notes: Space with grass near sport field. Very quiet, just people who make hike and bike during day.

quebec-wild.name: Riverside
quebec-wild.notes: We good this by accident. beautiful during spot. The if a pit toilet and tables. It looks like it would make a great place to swim but there are no swimming signs everywhere.

quebec-wild.name: Ottawa River - Boat Launch - Acre Road
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice spot. 
Established boat launch. 
Some locals dropping by to fish and launch boats and canoes throughout the day but quiet at night. 
Cell service is spotty, had to walk a bit on the side of farmers field to the North, go out on the rock point or go back on Acre Road a half a kilometre.

quebec-wild.name: Gravel pit
quebec-wild.notes:
Gravel pit suitable for any vehicle.

There are better sites along route 4 as you head south to route 1, however I didn’t stop for photos.  Route 4 is gravel, but very well maintained.  Some switchbacks that could be difficult in a RV.

At the time of writing, ioverlander had no sites along this route so thought I would provide info for those wondering.

quebec-wild.name: Hartland Covered Bridge
quebec-wild.notes: Parking lot beside the world's  longest covered bridge. Used to be a rest area but part of the infrastructure is gone. Lots of room and nice views on the waterfront and bridge.

quebec-wild.name: Small parking place near motorway
quebec-wild.notes: ok so this isn't the best place ever, but we needed a place just off the highway to wait for the ferry. It was fairly quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Bark Lake
quebec-wild.notes: Lots of sites along this lake, unfortunately most are taken by RVs that seem to stay there permanently.  Most likely area to find a site is right off the highway.  Beautiful aside from the annoyance of some of the best sites being held permanently.  Any car could reach these.

quebec-wild.name: Domaine de Gaspé (southern entrance)
quebec-wild.notes: Southern entrance of Domaine de Gaspé (one of Saint-Jean-Port-Joli's municipal parks). Basically a parking on the side of chemin du Golf. Close to the railroad.

quebec-wild.name: Osgood river parking
quebec-wild.notes: Free Municipal City large parking for cars and huge RV Very quiet during night, also day time. Very nice with park for play and lunch. Along a very nice river and safe swimming in river close to the established camping nearby. With a charming 4 kms foot path. With free municipal wi-fi from 8h to 17h. Gravel for parking cars and grass for pick-nick. Tables available. Toilets available near and in the municipal office. Manège toys for kid

quebec-wild.name: Rivière au Bouleau
quebec-wild.notes: Parking area beside river. Wide beach. 3 or more rigs possible. No interdiction sign. Easy access. Close to the road.

quebec-wild.name: Spot beside brook
quebec-wild.notes: Area off TCH. Salmon river fishing spot. Good for small to medium rigs. Level, gravel area. Good for an overnight stay. Fire pit available. No bathrooms.

quebec-wild.name: Halte routière La Guadeloupe
quebec-wild.notes:
Grass park with picnic tables and drinking water (?)

Parc gazonné avec tables à picnic et eau potable (?)

quebec-wild.name: Black Bank
quebec-wild.notes: Area by the ocean. Used as beach parking by locals. Views of the ocean and quiet at night.

quebec-wild.name: Saint Adelphe
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice little parking by the river.
Big rig and pet friendly.
No running water, but pit toilets and picnic tables.
Very quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Halte routière Anse à Norbert
quebec-wild.notes: Rest area with picnic table and small paved road with parking space for a few van by the water. Nice walk on the beach to reach an island when not at high tide.

quebec-wild.name: Fishing area
quebec-wild.notes: A large parking area for fishing. There is a small pier and table and fire pits. Very very large amounts of mosquitos when we stayed in June. But very beautiful.

quebec-wild.name: Old quarry
quebec-wild.notes: This is a pretty great location. We parked just off the road but you can drive down into the quarry where there are a vast number of places, and all pretty flat too. Bonus is that there is a bit of 4g signal on public Mobile. And the other bonus is that there aren't many bugs. Nice place!

quebec-wild.name: Parking area
quebec-wild.notes: A massive place for many band and tents on a large gravel parking area next to the highway and not far from Matagami town centre. There is w water point very close towards the centre. When we were there there was a temporary toilet and sink. The south days 48hrs parking. All good!

quebec-wild.name: Tadoussac Gravel road
quebec-wild.notes: A gravel road near Tadoussac. Surrounded by trees and near a small river. May be a little noisy due to the Fjord road nearby, but a lot of places to park your small RV or RTT.

quebec-wild.name: Les Cenelles
quebec-wild.notes: Small opening in a small trail.  It's large enough for 2-3 SUV.  No cell service.  A fire ring already existed in that spot. The main access trail is part of a off-road spot. Can be busy during the day but very quiet at night.

quebec-wild.name: Roadside
quebec-wild.notes: Nearby camping was full, but this place was ok for a night. The road is very quiet after 11pm and the bugs were far less than other places too. Amazing sunset.

quebec-wild.name: Semi-working quarry with lots of space
quebec-wild.notes: We found this by accident, the quarry is still working but there is a large flat area that you can camp safely on, away from any machinery and very quiet. No noise from the road at all. Pretty good for a night.

quebec-wild.name: Lake Danger
quebec-wild.notes:
Wild campsite (platforms) under the trees, near the lake Danger and close to the border.
Need a 4x4 to go there. From the closest trailhead parking, it’s a short walk to get there.

quebec-wild.name: Gravel pit
quebec-wild.notes: Very large place, where we can't sleep ..close to the road.

quebec-wild.name: Site de la Consol
quebec-wild.notes: Nice overnight parking, overlooking the bay on the Saguenay river. There is a kite park and a beach access. A little close to the main road so it is a bit noisy up to 23:00 but pretty quiet after that. Safe place. Dump station nearby

quebec-wild.name: Lac Sauguay
quebec-wild.notes: Free established sites along the walking trail. One right at the parking lot, another that is in poor condition along the trail, and the furthest (this one) is worth the walk. Some traffic noise, tent platform, privy, picnic table, fire ring.

quebec-wild.name: Halte Municipale Deschambault
quebec-wild.notes:
"Village Relais" rest area by the river.

Halte routière "Village Relais" au bord du fleuve.

quebec-wild.name: Banquise à ouest de Marsoui
quebec-wild.notes:
Located 2 km west of Marsoui, a gravel site that can accommodate more RVs.
No indication forbids us to park
Beautiful sea view
But landscaping is very simple as gravel and rock as on March

quebec-wild.name: Halte routière municipale
quebec-wild.notes:
3 or 4 RV spaces
3 picnic tables and trash cans
River view

---
Espaces 3 ou 4 VR
3 tables a picnic et poubelles
Vue sur le fleuve

quebec-wild.name: Parking du Mont Ham
quebec-wild.notes:
In front of the beginning of the trails, large parking lot with quieter areas.
Sleep in your van or Put up a tent.

En face du début des trails, large parking avec des zones plus tranquille. 
Dormir dans son van ou Mettre une tente.

quebec-wild.name: Quai fédéral, Chibougamau
quebec-wild.notes:
Large car park by the lake. Great view, very quiet.

Grand stationnement devant le Lac Chibougamau. La vue est magnifique. Très tranquille. Aucun service.

quebec-wild.name: Chapel Island
quebec-wild.notes:
large open area on bras d'or lake. located at Potletek Mi'kmaw first nation overlooking chapel Island. Great view! 
free camping and has a dump station. No bathrooms or water. Has good cell signal.

quebec-wild.name: Terrain vague sentier VTT
quebec-wild.notes: Beginning of a mountain bike trail overlooking a vacant lot. Small hill to descend before arriving on the ground, but doable with our honda fit. Very quiet, little traffic and away from the road. You can pitch your tent next to your car away from the path

quebec-wild.name: Secluded beach spot
quebec-wild.notes: Away from the crowd of Halte Plage. A little bit after the Halte Plage point towards Rivière-au-tonnerre. We were alone, and slept to the sound of the waves. Drift wood around for a nice fire. Highly recommend!!!

quebec-wild.name: Lac metabeskega
quebec-wild.notes: Little place, very quiet, close to the lake.

quebec-wild.name: Beaucage
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice spot with picnic tables, garbage, toilets and a view on the lake.
A bit noisy because of the highway next to the spot !!

quebec-wild.name: Pointe-aux-lièvres Parking
quebec-wild.notes:
Street parking near Rivière St-Charles hiking/biking trail. Noise from the highway nearby. No « no overnight parking sign ».
--
Stationnement sur rue aux abords du sentier piéton/cycliste de la Rivière St-Charles. Bruit de l’autoroute à côté. Aucune pancarte interdisant le stationnement de nuit.

quebec-wild.name: Parc Paul-Pratt
quebec-wild.notes:
Parking 24h authorized small park and cycle track right next door. Very quiet for one night. 


Parking 24h autorisé petit parc et piste cyclable juste à côté. Très tranquille pour une nuit.

quebec-wild.name: Lac Doreen
quebec-wild.notes: About 100m from the road on a narrow way down to the lake. A high roof van will pass slowly, but probably not a C class or anything wider than a van. Nice quit spot with enough place for 2 van or tent. Access to the lake, fire pit. Ground is level.

quebec-wild.name: Point Deroche Beach
quebec-wild.notes: Huge grassy parking lot on the right side before you cross the bridge and get to the end of the road, there is also parking at end of the road right before beach but more privacy in grass lot. Easy access to a beautiful white sand dune beach with great swimming. Nice road in. No facilities. Good cell reception.

quebec-wild.name: Mont Valin
quebec-wild.notes: Narrow gravel road climbing a hill. Semi-rough road, but I pass with a high roof 2x4 van. Many spot on this hidden road.

quebec-wild.name: Road stop
quebec-wild.notes:
Small road stop near the road. A few cars or trucks can spend the night and make noise. But it is still very quiet at night. We slept well there.

Petite halte routière près de la route. Quelques voiture ou camion peuvent passer la nuit et faire du bruit. Mais c’est quand même très tranquille la nuit. Nous y avons bien dormis.

quebec-wild.name: ste Irène
quebec-wild.notes: we have large parking just near mountain

quebec-wild.name: Place Lagny
quebec-wild.notes: 24h parking open all year round. Not on a busy street, so there’s not a lot of traffic at night.

quebec-wild.name: The Marsh
quebec-wild.notes: Near a Marsh on the road to a beach near Havre St-Pierre

quebec-wild.name: Point de vue sur La Baie
quebec-wild.notes:
Cute viewpoint by the river, on the side of the road. Might be a bit noisy as the cars drive by but it wasn’t that bad at all. Access to picnic tables and garbage. Beautiful sunrise and sunset :)
We stayed one night without any trouble!

quebec-wild.name: Waterside
quebec-wild.notes: There is a very nice spot behind the church with a view of the marina

quebec-wild.name: Commerce de la Fourrure de Lachine
quebec-wild.notes: This is a pay parking by the water in Lachine. Pay times are 9am to 9pm, otherwise free. Close to a walking and cycling path. There are a lot of cars and pedestrian going by. We slept there one night with no trouble. We saw many police cars and not a single one came to meet and greet us. There are even 2 dedicated bus parkings on site

quebec-wild.name: Stationnement municipal d’Acton Vale
quebec-wild.notes:
Very nice city park with free parking. No overnight restrictions but the park if off limits between 11pm-7am (The parking is fine)

Water games, fitness equipment, play area, clean restrooms. Near water with a waterfall at the end of the park. 

Very lovable place.

quebec-wild.name: KM 1244
quebec-wild.notes: Large parking lot overlooking Route 138. Unobstructed view of the bog. Perfect to spend a night.

quebec-wild.name: Halte Routiere Ste-Julienne
quebec-wild.notes:
Medium sized parking next to the road. There’s 4wheeler trails and two little ponds, picnic tables and trash cans. There are no signs that indicate parking restrictions.
Toilets are closed at the time of writing because of Covid (2020)

quebec-wild.name: Place du centenaire de Shawinigan
quebec-wild.notes:
24h parking next to busy road.
There is a porter-potty and picnic table next to bike path and a little paved pedestrian trail that takes you near the river. View on Falls

quebec-wild.name: Stationnement Rivière (Pont couvert)
quebec-wild.notes:
Parking with 5 places, toilets, big park with a nice river. We stayed the night and enjoyed it. We were 4 people during the night (3VR and one pickup) and 1 more with a regular car in the morning. Lot of mosquitos. No camping sign for tents.

 Parking avec 5 places, wc, cabine pour se changer, gazebos, belle rivière avec un pont typique de la région. Très pratique. On était 4 pendant la nuit (3 vans + 1 pickup) et 5 au petit matin, avec une voiture en plus. Beaucoup de moustiques. Panneau « NO CAMPING » pour les tentes.

quebec-wild.name: Cap Auguet
quebec-wild.notes: Nice beautiful quiet spot close to lighthouse but road is washed away on the way to it you cannot drive all the way to it but there are spots by the road to park overnite and turn around our 8m sprinter.

quebec-wild.name: Papineu Creek
quebec-wild.notes: nothing special right by the road. small gravel area by the bridge over the papineu creek. can access creek.

quebec-wild.name: riviere moisie
quebec-wild.notes:
Great no services but great view. Sand pit
super pas de service mais super vue.pit de sable

quebec-wild.name: Lower Twin Lake
quebec-wild.notes: just a pull of by the road, which is a nice drive. lake access and fire pit. pretty loud during day because of the road.

quebec-wild.name: Magpie
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice spot at the entrance to the village of Magpie, possibility to stop on both the left and right, view of the square. Very beautiful bay.

Joli spot à l’entrée du village de Magpie, possibilité de se parer à gauche ou à droite, vue sur la place. Très belle baie.

quebec-wild.name: Sortie du village de magpie
quebec-wild.notes:
Beach, view of the church. Nice pier, no prohibition sign.

Plage, vue sur l’église. Belle jetée, pas de signe d’interdiction.

quebec-wild.name: Wild Cove
quebec-wild.notes: Crown land, not suitable for large campers path down kind of tight, small water crossing passable in a 2wd.

quebec-wild.name: Halte non indiqué
quebec-wild.notes:
At the exit of Sheldrake, just after the bridge, take the small dirt road on the right, and at the fork keep right, you will not regret this stopover with several corners with a view directly on the edge of the river. Garbage can, maintained by the city, but not marked on the side of the road.

A la sortie de Sheldrake, juste après le pont, prendre la petite route à droite en terre, et à la fourche gardez votre droite, vous ne regretterez pas cette halte avec plusieurs coin avec vue directement sur le bord du fleuve. Poubelle, entretenue par la ville, mais pas indiqué sur le bord de la route.

quebec-wild.name: Rue des pêcheurs
quebec-wild.notes: Very Nice spot near the wharf of Magpie.  Places for 10-12 rings along the Gravel Road.  Very quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Bala
quebec-wild.notes:
No "no overnight" parking signs, there's a public washroom just up the street open all night. Off the main road.
OPP came by at night to check on us - he said he was making sure we weren't "the kids that come here to drink". He even saw our empty beer from dinner and said nothing. Wished us a good stay. No worries at all, and OPP confirms there's no bylaw at night anyways.
Beautiful view to wake up to.

quebec-wild.name: Mingan
quebec-wild.notes:
Wild camping on the beach.


Camping sauvage sur la plage
Gros coup de cœur

quebec-wild.name: Pull out
quebec-wild.notes: Once you pull in, off the main drag, to your left will be a little dead end perfect for a fire. Little downslope driveway. Hardly any bugs, yay! Quiet and cozy. Perfect for Judy our minivan. But you could definitely have the space for a small trailer. :)

quebec-wild.name: Bois derrière la micro
quebec-wild.notes:
Small wooded area with a stream, otherwise large parking for an RV.

Petit boisé avec un ruisseau,
sinon grand stationnement pour un VR

quebec-wild.name: Boat launch near river / Descente de bateau proche rivière
quebec-wild.notes:
Boat launch off highway in front of river.
Large flat parking with pit toilet.

Descente de bateau 
Terrain play avec une toilette

quebec-wild.name: municipal parking Shawinigan
quebec-wild.notes:
Municipal parking lot allowed for 24h maximum. No no overnight signs so seems ok to stay there for the night
Just next to the city centre, water front, restaurant. However there's a bit of traffic with a bridge just above

quebec-wild.name: Sentiers
quebec-wild.notes: To get to Place Franquelin. Turn here, signs for trails and then there is the choice to go left or right on a gravel path, go left. It is a path to meet. We went with a 19 foot trailer and a 6 foot crewcab box pickup and that’s our limit to return. --- Pour vous rendre a la place Franquelin. Tourner ici, pancarte sentiers et ensuite il y a le choix d’aller a gauche ou droite dans un sentier de gravel, aller a gauche. C’est un chemin a rencontre. Nous nous sommes aller avec une roulotte de 19 pieds et un pick up boite de 6 pied crewcab et c’est la limite d’apres nous pour ce retourner.

quebec-wild.name: Mingan
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice spot at the end of the road with possibilities from tent to middle rig. 
Access by a dirt road.

quebec-wild.name: JH43+F9 Boucherville, Québec, Canada
quebec-wild.notes:
Great sleeping place behind the library, no disturbance, no no-sleep sign.


Super place dodo derrière la bibliothèque, sans dérangement, pas de signe interdiction de dormir.

quebec-wild.name: Rue Roger-Smith
quebec-wild.notes: Gravel cul-de-sac on a marked street. Very quiet, totally dark. No service. Level’ish. Great for a one nighter.

quebec-wild.name: Crown Land WeyerHauser rd
quebec-wild.notes:
Waterfront camp site with a fire ring. 

Track entrance is narrow but short and the sun sets over the lake. Aces.

quebec-wild.name: Concrete Flat in Sand Pit
quebec-wild.notes: level concrete flat for a van or two in something that looks like an ATV sand pit. very quiet and discrete. easy to reach.

quebec-wild.name: Chemin Saint-Thomas Nord
quebec-wild.notes: Several possible spots along this road, close to the National Park Sentier des chutes/Montagne blanche trailhead. A local drove by and was OK with us spending the night. She only warned us we would probably hear cowbells during the night, as there is a farm nearby. She also asked we (obviously) left the spot clean. Town is nearby for facilities. Very quiet place.

quebec-wild.name: Gravel Road
quebec-wild.notes: Just a gravel road with pull offs. Suitable for vans or smaller rigs. Can hear the street during day but quiet at night. Fishing site available on the other side of the paved road by the river.

quebec-wild.name: Chaîne des Lacs
quebec-wild.notes: Nice Camp spot near a boat ramp. Acces road is narrow and a little rough. No services at all, dry toilet near. Few picnics tables. Nice place to stay a day or 2.

quebec-wild.name: Large space by lake / grand espace sur le lac
quebec-wild.notes:
Large area with boat launch near lake
Can hardly hear the traffic
Entrance is on the west side (south bound 117)
--
Grande place au bord d’un lac avec descente pour bateau
On entend presque pas la route
L’entrée est côté ouest de la 117 sud

quebec-wild.name: Waterfront gravel parking
quebec-wild.notes: Open parking area right on the water. Perfect for sunsets. Super windy the day we were here. Lots of room for many vehicles, we had one more car overnight with us. There is a house further along though. They have a yellow gate and didn’t seem to mind we were here. Few people drove by in the morning.

quebec-wild.name: Mispec Beach  parking lot
quebec-wild.notes: No “no overnight parking” signs. Parking lot overlooks the absolutely breathtaking view of the beach. We had no problem, except one car came late in the night and had some music playing.

quebec-wild.name: “The Guzzle”
quebec-wild.notes: Small public parking lot where people are welcome to enjoy the views of the area. Level enough, no “no”’signs. It’s also a research area for migrating birds and has info about the dikes. Water views surrounded by farm land,at the end of a short dirt road.

quebec-wild.name: Close to Grande-Vallée
quebec-wild.notes:
Beautiful spot, looking over a village, with 8 picnic tables, 3 being covered.

Très bel emplacement de 8 tables dont 3 couvertes avec vue en surplomb, beaucoup d'espaces/

quebec-wild.name: Teapot lake roadside
quebec-wild.notes:
SEE PICTURE!
Enough space for maybe 2 cars or a van on a small patch right on the side of the road next to the lake. 6x6 flat area dug out for text on hill.
Very quiet spot with the occasional ATV passing by.
Boat ramp further south with more room.

quebec-wild.name: Boat launch au lac Blouin
quebec-wild.notes: Big parking lot next to boat launch, suburb of Val d’Or.

quebec-wild.name: Centre communautaire Weller de St. Catharines
quebec-wild.notes:
Very quiet location, we had a very good night. No signs indicating a parking restriction at night. Access to a playground, picnic table, boubelle.


Emplacement très calmes, nous avons passé une très bonne nuit. Aucune enseigne indiquants une restriction de stationnement la nuit. 

Accès à un terrain de jeux, table de picnique, boubelle

quebec-wild.name: Battery Lake
quebec-wild.notes: Recharge your good vibes at Battery Lake. Oh that sweet, sweet crown land. I came by bicycle, don't think you could drive. Worth pedalling all those gnarly hills for the sweet view, benches and fire pit. Pack out yer trash kids!

quebec-wild.name: La Halte du pont couvert
quebec-wild.notes: Official site for fishermen to leave their trailers while they go fishing on the river.

quebec-wild.name: Campbell’s Bay, Qc
quebec-wild.notes: Parking along à gravel Bike path (route verte), in front of a play park and splash pad. Picnic tables situated in the park. Access to the Ottawa river via the municipal dock right by the park. Small convenience store within walking distance and a microbrewery a short walk away for locally brewed beer and german inspired food. Quiet location with lots of great views

quebec-wild.name: Metchin River
quebec-wild.notes: There is a small road just to the west of the Metchin River Bridge. It leads to a closed work camp and huge gravel pits. There is plenty of room for any size rig. There are no amenities but it’s not bad for a night. It’s quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Avant le lac Moulin
quebec-wild.notes: Just before you arrive at the lake Moulin, turn to the right. You will see a place with à firepit. We asked to a guy parked in front of the lake and he suggested us to go there for the night, as there is no "camping forbidden" sign.

quebec-wild.name: randonnée pédestre Berthier
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice place for overnight parking. Nice hiking trail. Garbage cans, recycling bin, pick-nick tables and one under a roof. Large parking lot at a trail head. Room for all size vehicles and rigs. VERY busy during the day but quiet at night, only small noise from the road.
--
Très bel endroit pour passer la nuit. Très belles pistes de randonnée. Bac de vidanges, bac de recyclage, pas de toilettes, tables de pique-nique. Grand stationnement.

quebec-wild.name: riviere Whisky
quebec-wild.notes: Small place just before the bridge. At the edge of the water, sandy bottom. Fire pit on site. Adjacent trail, perfect for Ebike. Boat descent on the other side of the bridge, very busy. Near a dump site and water.

quebec-wild.name: On the 172 road
quebec-wild.notes: open area on the 172 road few meters on the right of the junction 138/172. not sure if overnight is authorized but no signs and nobody said anything. spent one night.

quebec-wild.name: Belvédère et halte routière de Saint-Narcisse
quebec-wild.notes: One of the most beautiful road pullout in the «Bas-Saint-Laurent». Washrooms and picnic tables (at least 5 or 6, placed on different levels and far away from each other) are accessible all year long. Astonishing sunsets make this place a must when travelling to Gaspesie!!

quebec-wild.name: Ancien depot de sable (sand pit)
quebec-wild.notes:
Between Km 8 and 9 on the highway 199 going to Havre-Aubert. 
Entrance in asphalt and dirt road after. No sign forbidding night parking. Close to Baie de pleasance beach. Leave the site cleaner than before your arrival. 


Sur la route 199 vers Havre-Aubert. Entre le km 8 et 9. Entrée asphaltée et en gravier ensuite. Aucune affiche interdisant le stationnement de nuit. Tout près de la plage de la baie de plaisance. SVP laissez l'emplacement  plus propre après votre passage. Soyez discret !

quebec-wild.name: Sainte-Lucie-de-Beauregard
quebec-wild.notes:
A quiet place near the river noir nord-ouest and walking distance to the town and to the entrance of the regional park the Appalaches. Ask the neighbors in front for permission. 

A petit coin tranquille près de la rivière noir nord-ouest et a distance de marche du village et de l'accueil du parc régional des Appalaches. Demander la permission au propriétaire en face.

quebec-wild.name: Roadside
quebec-wild.notes: Trails to crown land. On the way to another location down Troutspawn road (dirt road). this is the large area by the road right off the highway. no signs or anything. highway has some traffic.

quebec-wild.name: Lookout Heights Place
quebec-wild.notes: Lookout over lake and city with nice views. Large paved parking area, trash bins, park benches, surrounded with trees. Not so quiet place to overnight. Good cell coverage, Verizon.

quebec-wild.name: Kingsey Falls  parking
quebec-wild.notes: A beautiful place to sleep with a river and fall sleep with a fall sound....

quebec-wild.name: Lac Patterson
quebec-wild.notes:
Can wild camp here for 3 days max at the lake picnic tables are there and 2 big parking lots. 
We were lucky to see someone fly a hydroplane above the Patterson lake. 

Possibilité de faire du camping sauvage pendant 3 jours max au lac Patterson avec table de pique-nique et 2 grands stationnements. On a été chanceux de voir une personne piloter un hydravion au-dessus du lac Patterson.

quebec-wild.name: West Beach
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice level ground next to beach. Simple fire pit in the middle of a turn around area. 

Beautiful view of Bay of Fundy, very rocky beach (no sand). 

Road is a bit rough getting in but still should be accessible with a smaller RV or car with care.

quebec-wild.name: Off the Highway
quebec-wild.notes: Plenty of space to park off the Hwy less than one Kilometre. Communications type tower. Room to turn around and park. Full bars of cell service. Please respect this site is very clean, trash free and quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Forest Road 451
quebec-wild.notes: Next to the road, small RV or tent. Close to river and road

quebec-wild.name: Halte routière
quebec-wild.notes:
Roadside spot, picnic area. No 'no camping' signs.

Gazebo en bordure de route avec un sentier menant une table de pique-nique à l’abri de la route. Vue imprenable sur la forêt! 
Pas de signe d’interdiction de camping et se stationnement de nuit. 

Gardez les lieux propres !

quebec-wild.name: Parc municipal de Frelighsburg
quebec-wild.notes:
Pedestrian way with city parking.  
.....
Stationnement municipal.

quebec-wild.name: Crown Land
quebec-wild.notes:
Easy access and close to the main road.  Expect some road noise.

Pretty much this whole road is crown Land.

quebec-wild.name: Crown Land Camping
quebec-wild.notes:
The coordinates will take you to the entrance.  

This is crown land, about 30 minutes from Resoule Provincial Park.

At the end of this"drive way" is the camp site. There isn't much of a turn around so if you have something bigger than a pickup truck, I suggest you just back in or find a different spot. 

There is only space for one rig, unless you are traveling with friends then you can park in tandem.

There is a bit of mud, I wouldn't suggest parking anything big here if it is wet.

If this spot is taken, try the next entrance which is just 10 seconds to the West. (I didn't investigate the other site but it looked similar on Google maps.)

quebec-wild.name: By the rock
quebec-wild.notes:
Wonderful site similar to the one listed close to Marsoui. It's right by the water and the road, with a little privacy if you go behind the big rock.
Montains behind too.
Reception is low for internet and ok for phone.
Terrain is not bad its was raining a lot but no mud really and was quite easy to find a flat spot.
There are 2 fire pits that we saw.
I don't have a picture of it, but the first part of the entrance would be fine for big rigs too.

quebec-wild.name: Parking Lot
quebec-wild.notes:
Without service or surveillance but very quiet and safe for short or medium term to park a vehicle of any size. We're walking to the Sauvé Metro.
...

Sans service ni surveillance mais tres silencieux et sécuritaire pour court ou moyen terme pour stationner un véhicule de toute dimension. On marche au Métro Sauvé.

quebec-wild.name: Lac Fiset
quebec-wild.notes: Can the Jeeps and others that are parking on the site..like near the campfire stop..site is rutted..ground is very soft, lets please keep it nice for all..best spot to park is on the road..that area just off the road leading to the site is a mess...and someone got stuck recently and left with huge ruts..good thing I have a spade..the site is nice, but hilly so very limited place to put tents.. 2-3 man tents only..road is not suitable for anything but a lifted 4x4..I have 9.3 inches of clearance and still hit twice..was going too fast..lots of noise from the ATV's there is a trail close by and they pass by the site as well frequently..

quebec-wild.name: Trail junction
quebec-wild.notes: Near main route.  There was 6-7 trucks passing that night.

quebec-wild.name: Beaver Dam
quebec-wild.notes: Small trail cut by a beaver dam.  Large enough for an SUV but fairly close of the route.  Very quiet in late fall.

quebec-wild.name: Rivière Rouge
quebec-wild.notes: Cute place between a small gravel road and Rivière Rouge for 1 or 2 VR. Transcanadienne Highway is across the river, so we can hear traffic but it’s not really disturbing. Access to the river (fishing?) and a small fire place was already there. We stayed one night without any trouble, the gravel road is not busy at all.

quebec-wild.name: Little Fire Pit
quebec-wild.notes:
The "giant fire pit" was taken so I had to drive farther in.  I found a spot that is easily accessible, no 4wd needed.

There was already a fire pit here but looks like it hasn't been used in a while.

Unfortunately, there is no lake view.

It's open though, good if you have solar panels.

Site includes some used asphalt shingles and chain link fencing!

quebec-wild.name: By the Bridge
quebec-wild.notes:
Sweet spot that I found on Crown land.  It's pretty tight.  There isn't much room to manoeuvre either.  
I'd say trucks and smaller vans only.  There is no way that a trailer would fit, you'd be blocking the road.  Also, the spot isn't level.

You will be rewarded with a nice view of the lake.

Keep in mind, you are right by the trail so there is no privacy.

quebec-wild.name: Moose River
quebec-wild.notes: A former gravel pit beside the river about 150 meters from main road. Turn off is just after you cross the Moose river bridge.

quebec-wild.name: Brush Fun Park
quebec-wild.notes:
I'm not sure what this lot is used for, however, I am sure that it is Crown land.

There is plenty of brush clippings on the side, so maybe something to do with logging.

Also, this area is clear and a bit hilly, so it looks like ATVs have fun here.  

You could probably come here with a trailer. I think there would be sufficient turn around space.

There was a trail that leads in the direction of the lake, but I didn't want to scratch my paint too badly so I skipped it and parked on the hill.

We're two minutes drive from Lake St. Peter Provincial Park.

Also, bring your friends, there is plenty of parking here for several rigs.

quebec-wild.name: Lookout
quebec-wild.notes: The lookout led to nothing but there was enough room for a couple of vehicles. We slept in our van 1 night. No signs indicating overnight parking was prohibited.

quebec-wild.name: Boat Ramp Parking
quebec-wild.notes: Parking by the 138 next to the Romaine. The parking is for the boat ramp, but there is no indication about overnight parking. Quiet even if close to the road. No amenities.

quebec-wild.name: Centre Lake Boat Launch
quebec-wild.notes:
Great place to swim ,camp or fish. Great lake for canoeing to a campsite.
You may camp anywhere on the lake, providing you are within 150' of the shoreline. You should remove any trace of camping when you are done and insure that your campfire is 100% as there are root fires that can develop otherwise.

quebec-wild.name: McKinley Ferry
quebec-wild.notes: Former ferry landing. Great spot to access the river but no fishing.

quebec-wild.name: Fairy Vista Parking
quebec-wild.notes: Nice spot at the start of Fairy Vista trail. You can park here and no issues at night for parking. No "No overnight parking" signs.  Nice spot to wake up to. Close to a water treatment plant, but you just hear vehicles driving on the roadway.

quebec-wild.name: By the lake
quebec-wild.notes: Nice quiet place by the lake. Pull in by the side of gravel road, walk about 30 metres to the lake and firepit. Enough room for a couple tents but uneven. Very quiet no traffic.

quebec-wild.name: Mont Chaudron
quebec-wild.notes:
Parking at the foot of Mont Chaudron, at the start of the path to go up there. little corner of paradise very very quiet, far from the road, to spend as much of the night as you want. The track to get there is dented but it goes smoothly with a normal car. Very good 4G connection. Take care of the place, take your waste, and give it lots of love! =)
--
Parking au pied du Mont Chaudron, au départ du sentier pour y monter. petite coin de paradis très très calme, loin de la route, pour passer autant de nuit que vous voulez. La piste pour y accéder est cabossée mais ça passe sans soucis avec une voiture normal. Très bonne connexion 4G. Prenez soin du lieu, emportez vos déchets, et donnez y plein d'amour ! =)

quebec-wild.name: Lac des Soeurs
quebec-wild.notes:
On the shores of Lac des Sœurs, a large car park that is very easy to access for all types of vehicles. Small beach for swimming, walking path in the forest. A few shaded areas for camping. Popular place, family but remains rather quiet. Sorry no photo, but ask google.
--
Au bord du lac des Sœurs, grand parking très facile d'accès pour tout type de véhicule. Petite plage pour baignade, chemin de promenade dans la forêt. Quelques coin ombragés pour camper. Endroit fréquenté, familial mais reste plutôt calme. Pas de photo désolé,.mais demande à Google.

quebec-wild.name: Mont-Bélanger
quebec-wild.notes:
Wild camping and hiking at Les sentiers Mont-Bélanger.


Les sentiers de randonnée du Mont-Bélanger offrent aussi des sites de camping rustique.

quebec-wild.name: Lake loop
quebec-wild.notes:
MODERATOR NOTE: No vehicle access!

Very small waterfront clearing with two picnic tables and a fire pit. Accessible by mountain bike trails, by hiking or biking. No room for big tents 2-3 person tents max. I accessed by bike and camped with a hammock tent in October 2020. No cost for camping, 10$ per day to access VELO MSM trails, paid by honour system/donations.

quebec-wild.name: Stationnement Belvédère
quebec-wild.notes:
Rotary Tower Tourist Site, Large parking lot that can accommodate large RVs.
.....
Site touristique de la tour Rotary, Grand stationnement pouvant accueillir VR de grande taille.

quebec-wild.name: Pont couvert Rouge
quebec-wild.notes:
Quiet place. Gravel path. On the edge of a river. Small wooden table. Uncrowded road. 
Place tranquille. Chemin d
e graviers. Sur le bord d’une rivière. Petite table en bois. Chemin non achalandé.

quebec-wild.name: Parking lot
quebec-wild.notes:
Parking lot close to the river . Room for 4 sprinter , parking without services or light , super calm ! 
Not good for big rigs , maximum 30’

quebec-wild.name: Lac Clary
quebec-wild.notes: extremely quiet spot on public land. water access. make sure you get a license before going fishing.

quebec-wild.name: Portage à Lila
quebec-wild.notes: Beautiful spot on the Rivière des Anglais (Englishmen's river), just up the Gadou waterfalls. Seems like an old "portage" spot: a place to take your canoe or kayak off the river. Firepit. Possible to swim. There was space to set our tent and fit our van. No signs saying that its a private property and a local drove by without stopping. Rough dirt road to get there, but we made it with our 2w van. Very quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Parc des capitaines
quebec-wild.notes: Behind the city hall in St Ulric, boat launch. Municipal rest area where camping is permitted. Directly on the river bank. Picnic tables and trash cans.

quebec-wild.name: Near River
quebec-wild.notes: Nice place with a few spots to camp. Some with picnic table and firecamp. View on the St-Laurent and nice little rock beach. Boat lunch.

quebec-wild.name: Saint Jean Vianney Overlook
quebec-wild.notes: Take Chemin des Terres Rompues from route 172. Keep your left at bottom of the hill and go to the end. you'll see a few other sites to your right by the river. Take a right up the hill for around 100m, a bit rough from there, but ok for cars. worth the drive up. amazing views.

quebec-wild.name: St-Donat Wild Camp Spot
quebec-wild.notes: Campspot in the wood. The road to get here is made of rocks and sand. We came here with our Santa Fe (SUV). You dont need a 4x4 but I dont recommend to come here with a small car. 1 bar LTE only. Fits 2 SUV or pickup truck

quebec-wild.name: Sand Pit
quebec-wild.notes: This is a nice large sandy camping area on Crownland. Far from this camping area but in the same sand pit is a spot for gun/archery shooting. Dead firewood around and I build camp fire area last year.  Accessible with regular car but I came with a Jeep.

quebec-wild.name: Open Area
quebec-wild.notes: Unfortunately somebody left an old BBQ here but other then that it's a nice open spot. In the middle of nowhere but very quiet and has a fire pit ring with dead wood around for fire.  Could be accessible with regular car probably but I would recommend 4x4.

quebec-wild.name: Lakeside
quebec-wild.notes: Awesome spot  on the lake but need good off road vehicle. Space for 2-3 trucks.

quebec-wild.name: Marina in St Felicien
quebec-wild.notes: Large parking lot at the marina, no sign of prohibited overnight parking. There's a restaurant, but seems open during high season only.

quebec-wild.name: Hunting road pit
quebec-wild.notes: There is an unmarked road accessible from the QC-381. After coming into the road, turn to the less used road on the right at the embranchment, continue until the end. The road is in good condition and there is space for an RV.  Probably tent friendly as well.

quebec-wild.name: Lac des Myriques
quebec-wild.notes: Old abandoned road on the QC-168 around km 87, next to a clear cut area, a lake and a small river. Out of sight but you can hear the road.

quebec-wild.name: Lac Blanche
quebec-wild.notes: Nice wild campsite next to a beautiful lake.

quebec-wild.name: Parc Chauveau
quebec-wild.notes:
With an area of 146 hectares, Chauveau Park is one of the largest green spaces in Quebec City.
.....
D’une étendue de 146 hectares,le parc Chauveau est l’un des plus grands espaces verts de la ville de Québec.

quebec-wild.name: Plage Monaghan Beach
quebec-wild.notes:
Right on the Beach a nice view with a garbage service.
.....
Directement sur la plage avec une vue imprenable sur les îles

quebec-wild.name: Black Lake
quebec-wild.notes: This is a small site off the dirt road, just before the bridge that crosses the lakes exit stream. It’s big enough for 2 medium sized outlanding vehicles, However it can be accessed and used by SUV, cars, trucks and vans. The little road into the site can be a little bumpy. Enough room for 1 vehicle if planning on using some space for a large tent. It has lake access right to the water and you can easily load a small aluminum boat or kayaks into the lake. This lake contains Pickerel fish species.

quebec-wild.name: Quai de ragueneau-quebec
quebec-wild.notes: Very Nice spot with Beautiful view. With dinosaurs! members of the council invited us to stay overnight. Place at least for 20 RV’s

quebec-wild.name: Notre-Dame dirt parking
quebec-wild.notes:
Pretty much the only place in town where you can legally park overnight, as the city bylaws explicitly say no street parking. Sign states “parking at own risk”, I’m guessing this is because of how soft the dirt becomes when it rains. I stayed 1 night and have a Honda CR-V and was fine.

There is an RV dump station about 50m down the road (well indicated with signs), a public bathroom at the dock (5 min walk) and 3 free wifi access points around town: the dock, the town rec center and the town gym (all within 1km of this spot and all seem to have a solid connection, no password required). I’m not sure if I should add these as amenities as they aren’t technically on-site, but if you’re reading this, you know they’re there 

There’s enough space for 5-6 regular-sized vans or 1-2 medium campers, but again, be careful not to sink in the dirt.

Please leave this spot cleaner than when you arrived!

quebec-wild.name: Bay of Fundy - Crown Land
quebec-wild.notes: There are 3 potential places you could camp here.  The coordinates take you to the one with the best view.  It is a small somewhat levelled off pullout near the end of the “drivable” part of the trail and is suited to a smaller rig.  The other two spots are located on either side of the trail a couple hundred feet from this spot and are much larger even accommodating trailers.  They both have water view from the sites, but is a much more limited view than the small site.  Just beware that the road coming in is rough.  It is passable with a 2WD for sure, but you will need to go slow.  Bringing trailers in here is likely doable, but you would want to drive very carefully.  The trail gets quite narrow in a couple places for a short stretch.  I’ve marked it big rig friendly only because they can fit easily in the campsites.

quebec-wild.name: Randonnée Scotch Cape
quebec-wild.notes:
Hiking trail parking, partly in the woods, not visible from the road
--
stationnement de randonnée partiellement dans les bois à l'abri de la route

quebec-wild.name: Chemin des terres rompues
quebec-wild.notes:
Take the Road chemin des terres rompues follow the road to the first street on your right. Chemin des terres rompues. (raspberries and garlic for sale sign) follow this dirt road to the end. Access to the left
--
Take thé Road chemin des terres rompues suivre le chemin jusqu’à la première rue à votre droite. Chemin des terres rompues. (pancarte framboises et ail à vendre) suivre ce chemin de terre jusqu'au bout. Accès à gauche

quebec-wild.name: Halte routière Chartierville
quebec-wild.notes: The place was suggested by local authorities. Up a hill with a view on one of the tallest mountain in the area. Close to the US border. Stayed one night. Not much traffic on the nearby road.

quebec-wild.name: Boat ramp area
quebec-wild.notes: place for 2 RV on pebbles, facing the water, next to a pier in a small bay. no prohibition sign. campfire area. quiet place but some urban rodeos nearby!

quebec-wild.name: Île-Sainte-Croix
quebec-wild.notes: Beautiful parking a few minutes away from downtown, no "no parking" signs, we slept there 2 nights and were alone, bathrooms are available during the day. I recommend to take a walk around the site. You can see the ocean !

quebec-wild.name: Cul de Sac near Airport
quebec-wild.notes: Follow Aviation Drive to the end where there is a cul de sac, lots of room, no “no overnight parking” signs. Highway traffic noise from highway behind the trees, and air traffic noise since it’s so close to the runway - not peaceful if you’re sensitive to noise, but it’s a convenient place to park if you need to use the airport.

quebec-wild.name: Traverse Blanc Sablon.
quebec-wild.notes: Nice spot near the wharf waterfront. Nice view on the ferry. See pics.

quebec-wild.name: Porcupine place
quebec-wild.notes:
Beautiful open place in the Mountain between Mount Morios and the dry Marthes, 4x4, trailer 20 feet, lots of wild animals, several fire pits here on site, gravel road.
.....
Magnifique endroit dégagé dans les
Montagne entre mont Morios et la sec des Marthes, SEUL au monde,
4x4, roulotte 20 pieds, beaucoup d’animaux sauvage, plusieurs pot à feu ici sur place, route en gravier

quebec-wild.name: Rest area
quebec-wild.notes: Old rest area along a dead end section of the old trans canada highway. There are no facilities here any longer but quiet and has a partial view of Saint John river. Large enough for any rv to turn around.

quebec-wild.name: Seaside
quebec-wild.notes:
Wild camping site at the seaside. 
.....
Camping sur bord de mer

quebec-wild.name: Le Sentier de l'Original
quebec-wild.notes: Off the beaten path, just a few Km from the 138, if you want peace, this is the place. Got there around 5 pm, minimum flies, saw only 1 car pass by in the next 12hrs. We saw more places to stop before this place.

quebec-wild.name: Near Manic-5
quebec-wild.notes:
It is quite hard to find a place to stop for a night near Manic-5... 
This place is close to the secondary road and it is good to park a camper or small VR (B or C). No water, no wifi, just nature.

quebec-wild.name: St-Angele (bécancour)
quebec-wild.notes:
St-angele road stop next to the river... toilet on site near route 132 on the other side... but nice place to spend the night... no indication that it is prohibited.. I will come back to it.
.....
halte routière de st-angele à côté du fleuve...toilette sur place près de la route 132 par contre...mais bel endroit pour passer la nuit...aucune indication que c'est interdit..j'y reviendrai

quebec-wild.name: Madawaska River
quebec-wild.notes: Amazing spot on the Madawaska River, a little tricky to get in, high clearance and 4x4 are not a bad idea, the road to get there is extremely bumpy and there were some large puddles along the way. We made it in a 2wd Ford e250 without any issues.

quebec-wild.name: P'tit Train du Nord
quebec-wild.notes: Nice place to stay at night. There is lots of space, tables and a toilet a few meters away when you cross the road. Can be a little noisy at night since it's just beside the highway but I had no problem sleeping.

quebec-wild.name: Serpentine Lake
quebec-wild.notes: Stunning lakefront camping on the beach. No services, 4 wheel drive recommended. It’s a 35km drive from the highway, but we’ll worth the trip. You will not be disappointed!

quebec-wild.name: Parc des Stations Montcalm
quebec-wild.notes:
Spent one night here while biking the corridor aerobique. 
I had messaged the town and they said I could park overnight at the Parc des Stations.
I stayed one night in my RAM Promaster and had no problems. Nice and quiet. 
It will only fit a vehicle that can park in a regular spot, so no big rigs.  There are flush toilets at the rest stop not too far from here.

quebec-wild.name: Amherst
quebec-wild.notes: Spent one night here while biking the corridor aerobique. I had messaged the town previously and they said it is allowed to park at this spot overnight (278 McLaughlin). It was nice and quiet, no problems. At the rest stop down the road there are bathrooms with flush toilets and you can fill up your water as well.

quebec-wild.name: Plage municipale de Squatec
quebec-wild.notes:
Beautiful spot next to the lake. Big enough for all kind of RV. 
Quiet, with garbage containers and recycling. 
.....
Très bel endroit au bord du lac. 
Très grand pour tout type d’équipement. Un peu en angle. 
Très tranquille. Poubelles et recyclage sur place, mais aucun autre service.

quebec-wild.name: Hwy 113 Sandy Clearing
quebec-wild.notes:
Sandy clearing on E side of Hwy 113.  Lots of space, a few small trees and brush, sandy soil, little grass.  No signage of any kind.  Some highway noise, but not bad as road is not very busy.  Nice bird sounds, only a few bugs.
Edit / update:  Sandy soft ground could be a challenge here. Easy to sink into the sand and get stuck.  We failed at our first exit path but found another way, fortunately without getting stuck.  Beware!

quebec-wild.name: Forest
quebec-wild.notes: nice and quiet spot just for one night. nothing amazing. nice walk in the forest

quebec-wild.name: Parc Dorimène-Desjardins
quebec-wild.notes:
Huge public parking next to a soccer field and only two houses. Very quiet location except for few teenagers racing by at night (a Saturday). Sorel now seems to forbid night parking everywhere, but not this place.
.....
Très grand stationnement aux abords d'un terrain de soccer et de deux résidences. Endroit très calme (malgré quelques adolescents coursant en voiture la nuit, un samedi). Aucune interdiction de stationnement le nuit, contrairement aux autres endroits de la Ville. L'éclairage y est sobre.

quebec-wild.name: Quai de Rivière-Pentecóte
quebec-wild.notes: Possibility to sleep a night or two, at the foot of the church. This is an old name abandon campground near the wharf. Parking without service. The view of the sea, bordered by sand dunes, is absolutely splendid.

quebec-wild.name: Gypsum Mine Trail
quebec-wild.notes: A nice parking lot with some flat spots. No sign saying no overnight parking. You can swim in the colored gypsum lake with about 10 minutes walk. Wonderful! Mountains are beautiful. Locals regularly come for a walk or swim. You can see the small road from parking, but it's not too busy. We were there a Friday night and it was calm.

quebec-wild.name: Ramp boat
quebec-wild.notes: Its really nice next to water.  Its a bit noisy next tobridge. Can’t do fire place. not in mexico its in Yamaska, Qc

quebec-wild.name: Lac des grèves
quebec-wild.notes: Beautiful lake and a rustic camp, sable and possible go with RV.

quebec-wild.name: Église de St-Jean
quebec-wild.notes: As described, large church paved parking lot by the water and grave yard. Sign clearly says you can stay here and suggests donation to help with upkeep. Toilets are across the street at the side of a small building to the left. There is a sign “Toilettes” on the side of the building. They are flush toilets with cold not potable water sinks. Clean with soap TO and paper towels. The box for donations is on the wall by the front door of the church. We stayed one night, very quiet as the road is not busy

quebec-wild.name: Quai Natashquan
quebec-wild.notes:
About 10 meters from the quay on the edge of the super quiet 10/10 river there are already existing holes .. suitable for motorized

À environs 10 mètres du quai sur le bord du fleuve super tranquille 10/10 il y a déjà des trous existant.. adapté pour motorisé

quebec-wild.name: Abandoned Old Mine
quebec-wild.notes:
Abandoned mine with many areas to camp.
Easy access by sand road.

quebec-wild.name: Roadside
quebec-wild.notes: A place outside of town limits.We pulled in with a 34 foot Airstream. It's not level ground but we managed to level one side pretty good. Lots of road noise during the day but we slept pretty well in the night. Please keep this place clean. Leave nothing it's a great little place to stay overnight. Full bars on cellphone.

quebec-wild.name: Clearing by the water
quebec-wild.notes: Dirt road leads to a clearing by the water. No signs, no amenities but we have some cell service and the view is beautiful at least!

quebec-wild.name: Stationnement La Nature d'Alexis
quebec-wild.notes: Gravel parking, beside a trailhead for the Les Sentiers d'Alexis. We were told at the Tourist Information Kiosk that overnight was tolerated there. Very quiet. No view, no amenities. Very residential area. PLEASE BE RESPECTFUL SO WE DON'T END UP LOSING ANOTHER SPOT! :: Be courteous, be respectful, be quiet, and leave no trace.

quebec-wild.name: Seaide
quebec-wild.notes: Nice place on the border of route 132 and the sea. good place for big RV. Nice view of the sea.

quebec-wild.name: Rest Area/Abandoned Campground.
quebec-wild.notes: Lots of spots, can bring any vehicle/trailer.

quebec-wild.name: Gallix
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice place. 2 picnic tables. It is a 2-3 minute walk to a lovely intimate beach. There is room for 10 cars or RVs. A toilet on site.

FRANCAIS
Belle place. 2 tables à picnic. On est à 2-3 minutes à pied d’une jolie plage intime. Il y a de la place pour 10 autos ou VR. Une toilette sur place.

quebec-wild.name: Backroads camping
quebec-wild.notes: Not the exact right coordinates but there are several clearings where one could easily park overnight. Be here before dark to find one! No signs, no amenities, a couple spots have fire pits. Near a beach and waterfall.

quebec-wild.name: Bord de mer
quebec-wild.notes:
Many places to stay overnight front of the sea with many Picnic tables.
Really pleasant. Meet some local fishers, they are really friendly and glad to share a beer with you.

Plusieurs stationnement le long de la mer avec des tables de picnic ainsi qu'au bout (beaucoup de gens font demi tour au bout donc un peu derangé en soirée) possibilité de se faire un feu plus loin sur la plage (un seul rond de feu)

quebec-wild.name: Beach campsites
quebec-wild.notes: Beautiful spot on the water. Tents ideal, it’s rocky coming down, 4x4 recommended. Cell service is just okay!

quebec-wild.name: By the water - Maclachlan
quebec-wild.notes:
Car park for a boat launch and near a path and a boat pass.


parking d'une mise à l'eau et près d'un sentier et d'une passe à bateaux.

quebec-wild.name: St-Fabien, Bas-Saint-Laurent, Qc
quebec-wild.notes:
At Arena, a playground, the blue sign on the road is marked : «Centre des loisirs». Follow the sign. 
Very large parking, back the building, quiet, closed the baseball field.

quebec-wild.name: Parking au Sentier du lac Castonguay, Amqui, Gaspésie, Qc.
quebec-wild.notes: 6 to 7 places for RV, close to very quiet rural road: Rang St-Joseph. At the entrance of the path along the lake.

quebec-wild.name: St-Marc-du-Lac-Long
quebec-wild.notes:
Very huge and quiet place, back to a school and a church. Using as a special dump for large and no-biological materials. Close to school patinoire for kids. However, very, very clean.
No services at all., but village services 200 hundreds meters below this apart wild camping place.

quebec-wild.name: Tourville
quebec-wild.notes:
Very large playground in front of a large building (school and municipality office).
Very quiet night we stayed.
No services.

quebec-wild.name: Black Lake
quebec-wild.notes:
Very huge parking lot between a high school and a baseball play ground. 
No services. 
Very quiet. 
All day Free wifi by the city.
No bother us for 2 overnight camping.

quebec-wild.name: Stationnement Atelier Cotier
quebec-wild.notes: Night Parking, in front of « Atelier Cotier ».  By the sea, nice place.

quebec-wild.name: Lake Theobald
quebec-wild.notes:
Large Gravel parking in the forest giving access to the lake. Really quiet. Just 2 kayakers in early morning. The gravel road going to the site is ok, lots of rock, just go slowly.
.....
Grand parking de gravel donnant accès au lac. Tranquille, juste 2 kayak tôt le matin. La route de terre y allant est pas mal rocheuse, faut aller lentement.

quebec-wild.name: East Bay Sand Bar
quebec-wild.notes: Great spot for overnight camping otw to Halifax or into Cape Breton. Lots of fresh water from the lake, plenty of available spots with picnic tables, and fire pits. Steady traffic and people during the day but after 11 pm we were the only ones here. Had no issues overnight.

quebec-wild.name: Rivière du Poste
quebec-wild.notes:
Nice spot next to the river. Beautiful view. Only inconvenient is that electric lines run across/above. 4x4 ideally required. 
See pictures.

quebec-wild.name: Plage municipale du Lac Simon
quebec-wild.notes: Nice spot to stay in the beach parking up the hill, little bit noisy during the evening but calm starting from 8pm, nobody around !

quebec-wild.name: In the bush.
quebec-wild.notes: Near the highway but very quiet where we park. To good access directly from the main road. Easy for camper up to 26 foot.

quebec-wild.name: Keppoch Mountain
quebec-wild.notes: Large Turnaround just off  the road. Stayed here while Mountain biking at Keppoch

quebec-wild.name: Passerelle Ulrick-Cherubin
quebec-wild.notes:
Very large parking lot near the « passerelle » crossing the Harricanna rive.  Nice view on the rapids and 2 minutes from down town.  Very quiet and nice view.

Très grand stationnement près de la passerelle et piste cyclable qui traverse la rivière Harricana.   Vue sur les rapides et à 2 minutes du centre-ville.  Très tranquille et superbe vue.

quebec-wild.name: Halte pique-nique à Cocagne

It is a stopover where to stop for a picnic. I slept one night in my van with no problem. There is no display saying that we are not allowed. Despite being in front of the road it was very quiet at night.

c'est une halte oû arrêter pique niquer. J'ai dormi une nuit dans ma vanne sans problème. Il n'y a aucun affichage disant qu'on n'a pas le droit. Malgré qu'on est devant la route c'était très tranquille la nuit.

quebec-wild.name: Parc de la Coulee Grou
quebec-wild.notes: Parking on the street is permitted, and there are places in the adjacent forest to put up a tent. I spent a peaceful night.

quebec-wild.name: Rivière Calumet

Really nice spot for 2-3 RVs, next to the river.
2 more spots higher up.
3 fire pits.

quebec-wild.name: Parking lot

Large semi-fenced grass / gravel recreational lot!

grand terrain de loisir gazonné/gravier semi clôturé! petit détour de l'autoroute mais qui en vaut la peine! légèrement bruyant du a l'autoroute qui passe tout près mais bel espace tranquille pour les chiens...

small paking beside 4h lac.
pit toilet is discusting.
lac is good for swimming.

.

quebec-wild.name: copper rand

many spots on the side of the lake.
some friendly locals spend summer here.
it is crown land.
very quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Howe Point

quebec-wild.name: Amable du Fond River. D&W stop.
quebec-wild.notes: Gravely/sandy look-out over Amable du Fond River. Right next to the road, leading to Kiosk Campground in Algonquin Provincial Park, but this spot is outside the park boundaries. THANK YOU"

quebec-wild.name: pedestrian trail parking

quebec-wild.name: Pointe Enragée
quebec-wild.notes: Beautiful rock flats beach. Surrender by magical view. Ocean and could see Anticosti Island. You can drive to this point.  There is a sign to keep the place clean. I have talked with a resident nearby and it is permitted to camp overnight.

quebec-wild.name: Maisonette
quebec-wild.notes: place to spend the night, small beach on the bay of caraquette.

quebec-wild.name: Dirt Road

Crown land about a mile in from Louisburg Main a Dieu Rd, large open area on top of a hill.  Quiet, you can see the ocean over the tree tops. Weak cell signal.
easy to get to the spot with low clearance 2wd vehicle.

quebec-wild.name: Dilligent River Beach
quebec-wild.notes:
Small parking lot to a small, local beach access. Space for a few cars. No big rigs.

Didn't stay overnight, but shouldn't be a problem. Drive slow in the neighbourhood!

quebec-wild.name: Belvédère Chute à l’Ours

Belvédère overlooking the chutes à l’ours rapids.

Un Belvédère directement après le pont qui donne sur les chutes à l’ours.

quebec-wild.name: Halte

Belle halte avec accès à la plage. De la place pour plusieurs VR. Pas de réseau, pas de toilettes.

quebec-wild.name: Sand forest

quebec-wild.name: Forêt Grandes Bergeronnes

quebec-wild.name: Au dessus de la route

Stationnement en gravier 
Juste à côté de la 138
Un peu plus haut que la route

quebec-wild.name: Labrador City
quebec-wild.notes: Sandy peninsula with beautiful view right on the the water, many spots available. Water bottom is glittery from the iron ore. Great cell reception.

quebec-wild.name: Plage du bassin de l'est
quebec-wild.notes:
Parking near the beach at the end of the Ch. du Bassin Est road.
There is a big and gorgeous beach.
Really quiet.

quebec-wild.name: Turn-off into the forest
quebec-wild.notes: Turn down this dirt-road off highway 224 and there are several trailside clearings for a peaceful overnight park-up. Most spaces big enough for 1 or 2 rigs, but drive as far as you want to find a space that suits you. No residences down here so you won't bother anyone. We couldn't find vehicle access to any lakeside spot, but there are a couple of spots you can walk through to the lakes if you explore. Trail is a bit rough and not suitable for big rigs with low-clearance, but most overlanding vehicles won't have a problem taking it slowly. A good nightstop between Truro and the coast.

quebec-wild.name: Spicers Cove Brook Apple river road
quebec-wild.notes: Parking area across from the beach. Just across a wooden bridge.

quebec-wild.name: Mont Sutton
quebec-wild.notes: Slept here last night. Very quiet. This morning a few class b motorhomes pulled in to mountain bike.

quebec-wild.name: Next to highway
quebec-wild.notes: Note: you cannot get onto here from the Hwy 20. Drive onto Rue Bellevue (go into the city) and reach this open gravel space. spot for locals to hang out on weekends, but should be good for a night's stay in a van or an RV. Highway noise, but good views. next to a fish farm, but no signs prohibiting camping or overnight parking.

quebec-wild.name: Pull off
quebec-wild.notes:
Large gravel parking area on Marconi trail. Glace Bay beach and bird sanctuary nearby.
Nice view of bay with a trail to the water.
Lots of road noise during the day but it quiets down late at night.
good cell signal with Bell and Telus.

quebec-wild.name: Boisvert Beach
quebec-wild.notes: Great spot for beach camping. Overnight parking seems to be permitted in the sand pit off the elbow of rue Boisvert. A trail leads to the beach. If you camp to the northeast of the parking, you'll be out of site of the street and any cottages.

quebec-wild.name: Sand Pit Point des Moints
quebec-wild.notes: An ok spot in the sand pit just off the road.

quebec-wild.name: Parc volleyball
quebec-wild.notes: Small parking on duma street in the small Saguenay with toilet, drinking water and picnic table I slept there two days in a row in my vehicle. No sign that says you can't be there and the people around didn't tell me anything since I was very discreet good for one or two vehicles.  --- Petit parking sur la rue duma dans le petit Saguenay avec toilette , eau potable et table de pique-nique j’y es dormit deux jours de suite dans mon véhicule. Aucune pancarte qui indique qu’on ne peut pas etre la et les gens alentour ne m’on rien dit  puisque j’etait très discrète bon pour un ou deux véhicules.

quebec-wild.name: Top of the road
quebec-wild.notes:
Small place not far from the other camp site near the water. I came to sleep here because there were too many people in the other place. Take the gravel path to the left and climb to the top, perfect spot to sleep in car.

Petite place non loin de lautre site de campement proche de l’eau je suis venu dormir la car il y avais trop de gens a l’autre endroit prendre le chemin a gauche en gravel et monter jusqu’en haut , spot parfais pour dormir en voiture

quebec-wild.name: Open meadow
quebec-wild.notes: Close to the road. Log trail . Middle of nowhere

quebec-wild.name: Stationnement ski de fond

Stationnement utilisé en hiver pour le ski de fond, aucune affiche ou indication qu'on ne peut pas dormir là.

quebec-wild.name: Plage Assomption parc Leo-Jacques
quebec-wild.notes:
Cyclotouring - Large beach with picnic table. Super spot, calm and quiet. Water fountain in the park

Cyclotouring - Grande plage avec table pic-nic. Super spot, calme et tranquille. Fontaine à eau dans le parc

quebec-wild.name: Grappling Brook Falls Trailhead
quebec-wild.notes:
Large parking area at the end of the road. 
There is a single parking spot 300meter down the road, just over the bridge next to a beautiful creek and lake. VERY quiet. Some cell phone reception. Arrive late, leave early

quebec-wild.name: Quai Shigawake

Small space/two-seater car park located at the top of the marina + Shigawake beach. Nice place for a fire.
